Mishneh Torah, Vessels of the Sanctuary:
Hakkohannim huvdelu mikkelal haleviyyim laavodat hakkarbanot shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 23 13)</small> "vayyibbadel aharon lehakedisho kodesh kadashim". umitzvat ase hi lehavedil hakkohanim ulekaddesham velahachinam lekarban shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 8)</small> "vekiddashto ki et lechem elohecha hu makriv":
Vetzarich kol adam miyyisrael linhog bahen kavod harebe ulehakdim otam lechol davar shebbikdushsha. liftoach battora rishon. ulevarech rishon. velittol mana yafa rishon:
Moshe rabbenu chillek hakkohanim lishmone mishmarot. arbaa meelazar. vearbaa meitamar. vechen hayu ad shemuel hannavi. uvime shemuel chillekam hu vedavid hammelech learbaa veesrim mishmar. veal kol mishmar umishmar rosh echad memunne. veolin lirushalayim laavoda mishmar lechol shabbat. umiyyom hashshabbat leyom hashshabbat hen mitchallefin mishmar yotze vehaacher shehu acharav nichnas. ad sheyyigmeru vechozrin chalila:
Umitzvat ase lihyot kol hammishmarot shavim bargalim. vechol sheyyavo min hakkohanim baregel veratza laavod oved vecholek immahem. veen omrin lo lech ad sheyyaggia mishmarcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "vechi yavo hallevi meachad shearecha" vegomer:
Bamme devarim amurim bekarbenot hargalim uvechilluk lechem happanim uvechilluk shete hallechem shel atzeret. aval nedarim unedavot utemidin en makrivin otan ella mishmar shezzemanno kavua vaafillu baregel. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 8)</small> "chelek kechelek yochelu levad mimkarav al haavot". kelomar chelek kechelek yochlu bekarbenot hatztzibbur. veen chelek kechelek bishar haddevarim shekkevar chalku otam haavot ukevaum kol mishmar umishmar beshabbatto:
Vechen avodat lechem happanim bammishmar shezzemanno kavua. aval avodat shete hallechem bechol hammishmarot. uminnayin sheeno medabber ella bargalim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "meachad shearecha mikkol yisrael" beshaa shekkol yisrael bain beshaar echad. uminnayin sheeno medabber ella bakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 8)</small> "chelek kechelek yochelu". veen sham mattanot bammikdash leheachel ella lakkohanim bilvad:
Vechen kohen shehaya lo karban hare ze ba lammikdash umakrivo bechol yom sheyyirtze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 6)</small> "uva bechol avvat nafsho" <small>(Devarim 18 7)</small> "vesheret". vaafillu chattato vaashamo hu makriv umechapper al yede atzmo vehaor shel karbano vaachilato shello. veim ratza litten et karbano lechol kohen sheyyirtze lehakerivo noten. veor hakkarban vaavodato leoto hakkohen bilvad shennatan lo:
Haya hakkohen baal hakkarban baal mum noten karbano leanshe mishmar vehaor shellahem. haya zaken o chole sheyyachol laavod al yede haddechak noten karbano lechol kohen sheyyirtze vehaor vehaavoda leanshe mishmar. veim eno yachol laavod kelal hare hakkarban kullo leanshe mishmar:
Haya tame bekarbenot hatztzibbur vechol hakkohanim temeim notno levaale mumin tehorim shebbeoto mishmar. veoro vaavodato leanshe mishmar hattemeim:
Haya hakkarban shel kohen gadol vehaya onen notno lechol kohen sheyyirtze veoro vaavodato leanshe mishmar. kevan shekkohen gadol haonen rauy laavoda kemo sheyyitbaer hare ze ose shaliach lekarbano:
Kol rosh mishmar umishmar mechallek mishmaro levatte avot. ad sheyyihye kol bet av vaanashav oved beyom echad mimot hashshabbat. vehaacher beyom shel acharav. vehaacher beyom shel acharav. ulechol bet av veav rosh echad memunne alav:
Umemannin kohen gadol hu rosh lechol hakkohanim. umoshchin oto beshemen hammishcha. umalbishin oto bigde kehunna gedola shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "vehakkohen haggadol meechav asher yutzak" vegomer. veim en sham shemen hammishcha merabbin oto bevigde kehunna gedola bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "asher yutzak al rosho shemen hammishcha umille et yado lilbosh et habbegadim". keshem shemmitrabbe beshemen hammishcha kach mitrabbe bivgadim:
Ketzad merabbin oto bivgadim. lovesh shemona begadim ufoshtan vechozer velovshan lemachar shivat yamim yom achar yom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 30)</small> "shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav". ucheshem sheribbuy begadim shiva kach meshicha beshemen shiva yom achar yom. veim avad kodem sheyyitrabbe bivgadim kol shiva o kodem sheyyimmashach kol shiva avodato keshera. hoil venitrabba o nimshach paam achat naasa kohen gadol lechol davar:
En ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe begadim ella par shemmevi kohen hammashiach im shagag beechad min hammitzvot shechayyav alehen chattat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 3)</small> "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta" vegomer. aval lishar haddevarim shavim hem:
En maamidin kohen gadol ella bet din shel echad veshivim. veen moshchin oto ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 13)</small> "beyom himmashach oto". vechen im nitrabba bivgadim bilvad en merabbin oto ella bayyom. veen memannin shene kohanim gedolim keachat:
Memannin kohen echad yihye lechohen gadol kemo hammishne lammelech vehu hannikra segan. vehu hannikra memunne veyihye omed limin kohen gadol tamid veze kavod hu lo. vechol hakkohanim mittachat yad hassegan:
Veod memannin kattikolin lihyot lassegan kemo hassegan lechohen gadol. veen pochatin mishshenayim. umemannim amarkalin en pachot mishshiva. umaftechot haazara beyadam ratza haechad liftoach eno yachol ad sheyyitkannesu kol haamarkolin veyiftechu:
Umemannin gizbarin mittachat yede haamarkolin. veen pochatin mishshelosha gizbarin. vehaggizbarin hem sheggovin kol hahekdeshot. ufodin et hannifde mehen umotziin otan bidvarim haruyin lahen lehotzian:
Kohen haggadol hammashuach kodem limrubbe begadim. umerubbe begadim haomed lesharet kodem lemashuach sheavar mechamat keri. vehaover mechamat keri kodem leover mechamat mum. vehaover mechamat mum kodem lechohen meshuach milchama. umeshuach milchama kodem lisgan. usegan kodem lekattikol. vekattikol kodem laamarkol. vaamarkol kodem legizbar. vegizbar kodem lerosh mishmar. verosh hammishmar kodem lerosh bet av. verosh bet av kodem lechohen hedyot mishshear hakkohanim. nimtzeu hakkohanim tamid shemone maalot zo lemala mizzo:
Kesheyyamut hammelech o kohen gadol o echad mishshear hamemunnim maamidin tachtav beno o harauy leyarsho. vechol hakkodem lenachala kodem lisrarot hammet. vehu sheyyihye memalle mekomo bechachma o beyira af al pi sheeno kemoto bechachma shenneemar bemelech <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". melammed shehammalchut yerushsha. vehu haddin lechol serara shebbekerev yisrael shehazzoche lah zoche leatzmo ulezaro:
Meshuach milchama en beno mitmanne tachtav leolam ella hare hu kishar hakkohanim. im nimshach lammilchama nimshach veim lo nimshach lo nimshach. ucheshekkohen meshuach milchama meshammesh bammikdash meshammesh bearbaa kelim kishar kohanim. maalin misserara lisrara gedola mimmenna veen moridin oto lasserara shehi lematta mimmenna. shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veen moridin leolam misserara shebbekerev yisrael ella im sarach:
Vechohen gadol sheavar avera shechayyav aleha malkot malkin oto bevet din shel shelosha kishar mechuyyeve malkot vechozer ligdullato:

Kohen gadol tzarich sheyyihye gadol mikkol echav hakkohanim benoy bechoach beosher bechachma uvemare. en lo mamon kol hakkohanim notnin lo mishshellahen kol echad lefi ashro ad sheyyaashir yoter meashir shebbechullan:
Veen echad mikkol ellu meakkev ella kol ze lemitzva aval im nitrabba mikkol makom nitrabba:
Vechayyav kohen gadol linhog kavod beatzmo. velo yakel beatzmo im shear haam velo yiru oto arum lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse velo keshemmistapper shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "hakkohen haggadol meechav" melammed shennohagin bo gedulla yetera. ratza hu sheyyirchatzu acherim immo harshut beyado:
Lo yikkanes levet hammishte velo lisudda shel rabbim afillu hem shel mitzva. aval holech hu im ratza levet haavel. ucheshehu holech eno holech beirbuveya im shear hakkohanim. ella mesabbevin oto hakkohanim vecholkin lo kavod. vehassegan mematztzeo beno leven haam. vehassegan umashuach sheavar mimino. verosh bet av vehaavelim vechol haam missemolo. veomer laavelim tenuchamu. vehen mechabbedin oto kefi kochan:
Met lo met eno yotze acharav. veeno yotze mippetach beto o min hammikdash. vechol haam baim lenachamo leveto. vehu omed beshura usegan mimino verosh bet av vechol haam missemolo. veomrim lo anu kapparatcha vehu omer lahem titbarchu min hashshamayim:
Ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal. veeno korea al meto kishar hakkohanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "uvegadav lo yifrom". veim kara loke. aval korea hu millematta keneged raglav. veeno marbe pera leolam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "et rosho lo yifra" vaafillu beet shello yikkanes lammikdash. ella mesapper meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. veeno mesapper betaar ella bezug rosh saara zo beikkar zo ad sheyyerae keillu hu tzamach keachat shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 44 20)</small> "rosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu kasom yichsemu et rashehen": 
Uvayit yihye lo muchan bammikdash vehu hannikra lishkat kohen gadol. vetifarto uchevodo sheyyihye yoshev bammikdash kol hayyom. velo yetze ella leveto bilvad ballayla o shaa o shetayim bayyom. veyihye beto birushalayim veeno zaz mishsham:
Kohen gadol dan vedanin oto umeidin alav. veen danin oto dine nefashot ella bevet din haggadol bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 22)</small> "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha":
Haya yodea edut eno chayyav lehaid vaafillu bevet din haggadol shezze eno kavod lo sheyyelech veyaid. veim hayta edut lemelech yisrael hare ze holech bevet din haggadol umeid lo:
Uchevar bearnu besefer kedushsha shehu asur bealmana umetzuvve al habbetula. veeno nose shete nashim veim nasa shetayim eno yachol laavod beyom hatztzom ad sheyyegaresh leachat. vecholetz vecholtzim leishto. umeyabbemin et ishto. veim geresh ishsha mutteret lehinnase lishar haam:
Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lahechol lehishtachavot shelosha ochazin bo. echad bimino veechad bismolo veechad baavanim tovot shebbaefod meachorav. veyikkanes lahechol veyishtachave. vechevan sheyyishma hassegan kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze magbiah lo et happarochet. veachar sheyyetze yikkansu echav hakkohanim veyishtachavu veyetzu:
Bechol yom sheyyirtze lehaketir hakketoret maktir venotel chelek barosh bekadshe hammikdash kullan. ketzad. kesheyyirtze omer zo hachattat shelli veze haasham shelli. veeno oved befayis. ella kol et sheyyirtze lehakeriv makriv kol ma sheyyirtze. vahare hu bekadshe haggevul kishar hakkohanim:
Bizman sherotze kohen gadol lehakeriv haya ole bakkevesh vehassegan mimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu. vehoshit lo hakkohen shehu molich et rosh haola haevarim shebbeyado vesomech alehen vezorkan laesh:
Vechach hayu moshitin lo shear haevarim. kol echad veechad noten haevarim shebbeyado larishon. veharishon noten lechohen gadol vehu somech vezorek laesh. veim ratza lismoch bilvad veyihye [kohen] acher zorek laesh ose. veen sham semicha al haevarim ella lechohen gadol bilvad mippene kevodo. aval kol hassemichot al baale chayyim hem:
Kesheyyigdal hakkohen veyease ish hare hu kasher laavoda. aval echav hakkohanim lo hayu menichin oto laavod bammikdash ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana. veeno nichnas laazara laavoda techilla ella beshaa shehaleviyyim omrim shira:
En hakkohen oved techilla vechen kohen gadol eno oved techilla ad sheyyavi asirit haefa mishshello veoved beyado shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 13)</small> "ze karban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai beyom himmashach oto". veim avad kodem sheyyavi asirit haefa vechen kohen gadol sheavad bichhunna gedola kodem sheyyavi asirit haefa avodato keshera:
Kohen shello avad adayin miyyamav shemminnuhu kohen gadol hare ze mevi asirit haefa veovdah beyado battechilla kishar chinnuch kol kohen hedyot veachar kach makriv asirit haefa sheniyya shehi chinnuch kohen gadol. veachar kach makriv asirit haefa shelishit shehi chavite kohen gadol shemmakriv bechol yom kemo sheyyitbaer umaase shelashtan shave hu:

I efshar sheyyihye karbano shel adam karev vehu eno omed al gabbav. vekarbenot hatztzibbur hen karban shel kol yisrael vei efshar sheyyihyu yisrael kullan omdin baazara bishat karban. lefichach tikkenu neviim harishonim sheyyivreru miyyisrael kesherim viree chet veyihyu sheluche kol yisrael laamod al hakkarbanot vehem hannikraim anshe maamad. vechilleku otam 24 maamadot keminyan mishmerot kehunna uleviyya. veal kol maamad umaamad echad mehen memunne al kullam vehu nikra rosh hammaamad:
Bechol shabbat veshabbat mitkabbetzin anshe maamad shel otah shabbat. mi shehaya mehen birushalayim o karov lah nichnasin lammikdash im mishmar kehunna uleviyya shel otah shabbat. veharchokim shebbeoto maamad kevan shehiggia maamad shellahen hen mitkabbetzin levet hakkeneset shebbimkoman:
Uma hen osin ellu hammitkabbetzin ben birushalayim ben bevatte kenesiyyot. mitannin besheni bashshabbat shellahen. uvishlishi uvirvii uvachamishi. aval beerev shabbat lo hayu mitannin mippene kevod shabbat uveechad beshabbat enam mitannim kede shello yetzu meoneg shabbat letzom:
Uvechol yom veyom mishshabbat shehaya maamadan mitpallelin arba tefillot shacharit umincha uneila veod mosifin tefilla acheret ben shacharit umincha vehi yetera lahen. venosin kappehen hakkohanim bamaamad shalosh peamim bechol yom beshacharit uvattefilla zo hayetera uvinila. vekorin besefer tora shelosha anashim shete peamim bechol yom beshacharit uvattefilla hashsheniyya shemmosifin aval bemincha lo hayu korin besefer tora ella al pe kekorin et shema. velo hayu mitkabbetzin litfillat mincha beerev shabbat mippene shehen terudin leshabbat:
Vekibbutzan lechol tefilla mearba tefillot ellu vaamidatan sham litfilla velitchinna ulevakkasha velikrot battora nikra maamad:
Uvamme hayu korin bemaase bereshit. bayyom harishon korin bereshit vihi rakia. bashsheni yehi rakia veyikkavu. bishlishi yikkavu vihi meorot. birvii <small>(Bereshit 1 14)</small> "yehi meorot" <small>(Bereshit 1 20)</small> "veyishretzu". bachamishi yishretzu <small>(Bereshit 1 24)</small> "vetotze haaretz". beshishshi totze haaretz <small>(Bereshit 2 1)</small> "vaychullu": 
Parasha gedola korin otah bishnayim uketanna kore otah echad. ushete parashiyyot shekkorin shacharit hem shechozrin vekorin otan bitfilla hashsheniyya bassefer. vechozrin vekorin otan bammincha al pe:
Shemonat yeme chanukka lo hayu anshe maamad osin maamad beshacharit. vechol yom sheyyesh bo karban musaf lo haya bo maamad lo bitfilla sheniyya shellahem velo bammincha. ella beshacharit uvinila bilvad. vechol yom shehaya bo karban haetzim lo haya bo maamad binila ella beshacharit uvitfilla sheniyya uvemincha:
Umahu karban haetzim. zeman kavua haya lemishpachot mishpachot latzet layarim lehavi etzim lammaaracha. veyom sheyyaggia livne mishpacha zo lehavi haetzim hayu makrivin olot nedava vezehu karban haetzim vehaya lahem kemo yom tov. vaasurin bo behesped uvetaanit uvaasiyyat melacha vedavar ze minhag:
Afillu yachid shehitnaddev etzim o gezarim bammaaracha asur beoto hayyom behesped uvetaanit uvaasiyyat melacha vedavar ze minhag:
Anshe maamad asurin millesapper umillechabbes kol shabbat shellahen. uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat. umippene ma asru alehem lesapper ulechabbes kede shello yikkansu lemaamadam keshehem menuvvalin. ella yesapperu vichabbesu mikkodem:

Chamisha asar memunnin hayu bammikdash vechen memannim leolam al kol davar mechamishsha asar devarim ellu memunne echad. veellu hen (1) al hazzemannim (2) al neilat shearim (3) al hashshomrim (4) al hameshorrim (5) al hatztziltzal im shear kele shir (6) al happeyasot (7) al hakkanim (8) al hachotamot (9) al hannesachim (10) al hacholin (11) al hammayim (12) al maase lechem happanim (13) al maase hakketoret (14) al maase happarochet (15) al maase bigde kehunna:

Kol echad veechad mimmemunnim ellu tachat yado anashim harebe kede lehachin hammelacha shehu memunne aleha. ze sheal hazzemannim hu vaanashav meshammerim et hazzemannim. kevan sheyyaggia et hakkarban machriz hu o echad meanashav birshuto veomer imdu kohanim laavoda uleviyyim ladduchan veyisrael lammaamad vechevan sheyyishma kolo yavo kol echad limlachto:

Ze sheal neilat shearim al piv noalin veal piv potchin veen hattokin tokin bechol yom liftichat hashshearim ella birshuto. uvechol yom tokin bammikdash shalosh tekiot liftichat hashshearim tekia terua utekia:
Ze sheal hashshomrim hu ish har habbayit shemmesabbev al haleviyyim bechol layla vechol mi sheyyashen al mishmaro malke oto bemaklo vesoref et kesuto:

Ze sheal hameshorrim hu borer bechol yom hameshorrim sheomdim al hadduchan lomar shira bappe. veal piv tokin al hakkarbanot. en pochatin bammikdash meachat veesrim tekia bechol yom. shalosh liftichat shearim. vetesha letamid shel shachar. vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim. veyom sheyyesh bo karban musaf mosifin tesha al karban musaf. veim chal rosh chodesh o yom tov lihyot beshabbat o shechal rosh hashshana lihyot beshabbat sheyyesh sham shelosha musafin en tokin lechol musaf umusaf bifne atzmo ella tokin tesha bilvad lechol hammusafin:

Beerev shabbat mosifin shesh. shalosh lehavetil et haam min hammelacha veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. uvaregel mosifin shalosh liftichat shaar hattachton vehu shaar ezrat nashim veshalosh liftichat shaar haelyon hu shaar nikkanor velamma nikra shaar elyon lefi shehu lemala meezrat nashim. vechen tokin shalosh lemilluy hammayim shemmenassechin bechag veen tokim lemilluy hammayim beshabbat. vetokin shalosh al gabbe hammizbeach beshaa shemmenassechin hammayim. vechol hattokim shettokim al hakkarbanot mittachat yad ze sheal hameshorrim uvirshuto. vechol ellu hattekiot bachatzotzrot hen:
Ze sheal hatztziltzal hu hammaamid kol hameshorrim al pi kele shir shessoadin im haleviyyim kemo shebbearnu:

Ze sheal happeyasot hu mefis ben hakkohanim bechol yom ad sheyyihye kol ish veish ose melachto shezzacha bah bappayis. vearba peamim hayu mefisin bechol yom uvehilchot temidin avaer ketzad hayu mefisin:

Hamemunne sheal hakkinnim hu shepposkin immo sheyyimkor hakkinnim lakkarbanot kach vechach bassela vechol mi shehu chayyav torim o shene bene yona yavi demehem lammikdash. veze hamemunne noten hakkinnim levaale hakkarbanot veose cheshbon im haggizbarin venotnin lo. mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom poskin immo hashshaar. veim huzelu hakkinnim maspik keshaar hazzol veim hukeru maspik kemo sheppasku immo sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. vechen ken shennimtza pasul o shennifsal kodem sheyyikkarev noten acher tachtav:
Ze sheal hachotamot hu shemmekabbel deme hannesachim mimmechuyyeve nesachim venoten lahen chotamot. veze sheal hannesachim hu shemmocher hannesachim:
Ketzad. arba chotamot hayu bammikdash. haechad katuv alav egel. vehashsheni katuv alav zachar. vehashshelishi katuv alav gedi. veharvii katuv alav chote:

Kol mi sheyyavi karbenotav lammikdash noten deme hannesachim leze hamemunne al hachotamot venoten lo chotamot keminyan hakkarbanot shello. veim haya metzora ashir noten lo chotam echad shekkatuv alav chote vehalla holech bachotamot shebbeyado leze hamemunne al hannesachim venoten lo nesachim keminyan hachotamot uchemo shekkatuv bahen velaerev baim ze etzel ze motzi et hachotamot umekabbel kenegdan maot im hotiru hammaot hotiru lahekdesh veim pachatu hammaot yeshallem ze sheal hachotamot mibbeto. mi sheavad chotamo mamtinin lo ad haerev im matzu bammaot yeter kede chotam shettoen notnin lo veim lav en notnin lo. veshem kol hayyom katuv al hachotam mippene harammaim shello yashhe hachotam etzlo ad sheyyukeru hannesachim:

Mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom poskin shaar hayyayin vehassolet im hamemunne al hannesachim. im hukeru nesachim mesappek lahen kemo sheppasku immo. veim huzelu mesappek lahen keshaar hazzol. vehassachar shemmistakker hahekdesh bisharim ellu hu hannikra motar nesachim velokchin bo olot lekayitz hammizbeach. veen mekayyetzin et hammizbeach beolot of sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur of:

Hakkohanim mippene shehen omdin al haritzpa tamid veochlin basar harebe veen alehen begadim bishat haavoda ella chaluk echad hem cholin bimehen. lefichach maamidin memunne echad sheyyihye mevakker otan umerappe kol tachluehen veosek bahen tamid hu vaanashav shettachat yado:

Vechen memannin acher lihyot chofer borot veshichin umetakken habborot shel rabbim kede sheyyihyu hammayim metzuyin birushalayim lechol echad miyyoshveha ulechol ole hargalim. veechad memunne al kol ummane lechem happanim vehu metakken kol melachto. veechad memunne al kol ummane hakketoret vehu metakken melachtah:

Ze sheal happarochet memunne al kol orge happarochot veharokmin bahen sheyyihyu muchanot lahechol velashshearim. ushete parochot hayu osin bechol shana lehavedil ben hakkodesh lekodesh hakodashim. vechute happarochet kefulin shishsha shishsha. vearbaa minin hayu bah shesh utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani. vechol echad mehen kaful shishsha hare arbaa veesrim chutin. vetefach haya avyah veal shenayim veshivim nirin hayta neereget arkah arbaim amma verachbah esrim amma:
Ushelosh esre parochot hayu bemikdash sheni sheva al shiva shaare haazara veachat al petach haulam veachat al petach hahechol ushetayim laddevir beno uven hakkodesh ushetayim kenegdan baaliyya:

Parochet shennitmet bivlad hatuma matbilin otah bifnim umachnisin otah miyyad lefi sheenah tzericha haarev shemesh. veshennitmet beav hatuma matbilin otah mibbachutz veshotchin otah bachel mippene shehi tzericha haarev shemesh. veim hayta chadasha shotchin otah al gav haitztabba kede sheyyire haam et melachtah shehi naa:
Vechol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash hayu lahem sheniyyim ushelishim sheim yittammeu harishonim yaviu hashsheniyyim tachtehem:
Ze hammemunne al maase bigde kehunna osek bahachanat bigde kohanim hedyotim uvigde kohen gadol uvaarigatan umittachat yado naasa hakkol. velishka hayta lo bammikdash:

Vigde kehunna shelosha minim. bigde kohen hedyot. uvigde zahav. uvigde lavan. bigde kohen hedyot hem arbaa kelim kuttonet umichnasayim umigbaot veavnet. vearbaatan shel pishtan levanim vechutan kaful shishsha. vehaavnet levaddo rakum betzemer:

Bigde zahav hen bigde kohen gadol vehem shemona kelim. haarbaa shel kol kohen. umeil veefod vechoshen vetzitz. veavneto shel kohen gadol maase rokem hu vehu dome bemaasav leavnet kohen hedyot. umitznefet haamura beaharon hi hammigbaat haamura bevanav. ella shekkohen gadol tzonef bah kemi shellofef al hashshever. uvanav tzonfin bah kechova ulefichach nikret migbaat:

Bigde lavan hem arbaa kelim shemmeshammesh bahen kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. kuttonet. umichnasayim. veavnet. umitznefet. vearbaatan levanim vechutan kaful shishsha umin happishtan levaddo hem. ushete kuttanot acherot hayu lo lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. achat lovshah bashshachar veachat ben haarbayim. ushetehem bishloshim mane mishshel hekdesh. veim ratza lehosif mosif mishshello umakdish hattosefet veachar kach ose bah hakkuttonet:

Bigde kehunna mitzvatan sheyyihyu chadashim naim umeshulleshalim kederech bigde haggedolim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 2)</small> <small>(Shemot 28 40)</small> "lechavod uletifaret". hayu metushttashin o mekorain o arukkin yeter al middato o ketzarim pachot mimmiddato o shessilkkan baavnet veavad avodato pesula. hayu meshochakin o shehayu arukkim vesilkkan baavnet ad shennaasu kemiddato veavad avodato keshera:

Kol beged mibbigde kehunna shennaasu tzoin en melabbenin otan veen mechabbesin otan ella mannichan liftilot velovesh chadashim. uvigde kohen gadol shebbalu gonzin otan. uvigde lavan sheoved bahem beyom hatztzom eno oved bahem paam sheniyya leolam ella nignnazin bammakom sheyyifshot otam sham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 23)</small> "vehinnicham sham" vehem asurin bahanaa:

Michnese kohanim hedyotim shebbalu veavnetehem hayu osin mehen petilot umadlikin bahen bammikdash besimchat bet hashshoeva. vechuttenot kohanim hedyotim shebbalu hayu osin mehen petilot limnorat tamid:

Kol bigde hakkohanim enan baim ella mishshel tzibbur. veyachid shehitnaddev beged mibbigde kehunna mosro latztzibbur umuttar. vechen kol kele hashsharet vaatze hammaaracha shemmesaran yachid latztzibbur hare hen kesherin. af kol karbenot hatztzibbur shehitnaddev otan yachid mishshello kesherim uvilvad sheyyimserem latztzibbur:

Bigde kohanim hedyotim hayu osin mehen machalatzot rabbot. veshishsha vetishim challon hayu bammikdash lehaniach bahen habbegadim arbaa challonot lechol mishmar. veshem kol mishmar katuv al challonotav. vechullan setumot. uchesheyyikkansu anshe mishmar laavoda bashshabbat shellahen potchin challonotehen kol yeme shabbatan venotlin hakkelim. uchesheyyetzu machazirin habbegadim lechallonotehen vesotmin:

Velamma asu arbaa challonot lechol mishmar. lefi shello yihyu hakkelim meoravin. ella kol hammichnasayim bechallon echad vechatuv alav michnesayim. vechol haavnetim bechallon echad vechatuv alav avnet. vechen hammitznafot kullan bechallon echad. vehakkuttanot kullan bechallon echad:
Kohen gadol manniach bigde zahav ballishka shello ballayla o beet sheyyetze min hammikdash:
Bigde kehunna muttar lehanot bahen. lefichach lovsham beyom avodato vaafillu shello bishat avoda chutz min haavnet mippene shehu shaatnez:
Asur lechohen hedyot lelovsho ella bishat avoda. en hakkohanim lovshin laavoda ella tzemer ufishtim bilvad:

Vechol makom shenneemar battora shesh o bad hu happishtim vehu habbutz. utechelet haamura bechol makom hi hatztzemer hatztzavua keetzem shamayim shehu patuch min hakkochal. haargaman hu hatztzemer hatztzavua adom. vetolaat hashshani hu hatztzemer hatztzavua betolaat:

Kol makom shenneemar battora shesh o shesh mashzar tzarich sheyyihye hachut kaful shishsha. umakom shenneemar bad im haya chut echad levaddo kasher. umitzva min hammuvchar sheyyihye kaful shishsha. umakom shenneemar bo mashzar bilvad tzarich sheyyihye chutan kaful shemone:
Kol makom shenneemar battora maase rokem hu shettihyena hatztzurot hannaasot baariga nirot mitztzad echad bifne haarig. umaase choshev hu shettihye hatztzura niret mishshene tzedadin panim veachor:

Vechetzad maase habbegadim. hakkuttonet ben shel kohen gadol ben shel kohen hedyot mishbetzot hayta shehi battim battim baarigatah kemo bet hakkosot kederech sheosin haorgin babbegadim hakkashim. uvet yad shelah neerag bifne atzmo umechabberin oto im guf hakkuttonet bitfira:
Orecha hakkuttonet ad lemala min heakev. veorech bet yad shelah ad pas yado. verachbo kerochav hayyad:

Hammichnasayim ben shel kohen gadol ben shel kohen hedyot hem mimmatnayim ad yerechayim shehu lemala min hattibbur karov min hallev ad sof hayyarech shehu haarkuva. ushenatzim yesh lahem. veen lahem lo bet hannekev velo bet haerva ella mukkafin kemin kis:

Hammitznefet shel kohen gadol o hedyot arko shesh esre ammot. vehaavnet rachbo kemo shalosh etzbaot vearko shenayim usheloshim amma. makkifo umachaziro kerech al gabbe kerech. uvigde kehunna kullan en osin otan maase machat ella maase oreg shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 32)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 22)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 27)</small> "maase oreg":

Ketzad maase hatztzitz. ose tas shel zahav rochav shete etzbaot umakkif meozen leozen vechotev alav sheni shitin kodesh laAdonai kodesh millematta laAdonai milmala. veim ketavo beshita achat kasher. ufeamim ketavuhu beshita achat:
Vehaotiyyot boltot befanav. [ketzad]. chofer et haotiyyot meacharav vehu medubbak al hashshaava ad shebbolet. vehu nakuv bishte ketzotav. ufetil techelet lematta mimmennu nichnas minnekev lenekev kede sheyyihye nikshar biftil keneged haoref:
Hammeil kullo techelet. vechutav kefulin shenem asar ufiv arug bitchillat arigato. veen lo bet yad ella nechlak lishte kenafayim missof haggaron ad lematta kederech kol hammeilim veeno mechubbar ella keneged kol haggaron bilvad. vehakkorea pi hammeil loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 32)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 23)</small> "lo yikkarea". vehu haddin lechol bigde kehunna shehakkoran derech hashechata loke: 
Umevi techelet veargaman vetolaat shani kol min mishshelashtan shazur shemona lefi shenneemar beshulav <small>(Shemot 39 24)</small> "mashzar". nimtzeu chute hashshulayim arbaa veesrim. veose otan kemin rimmonim shello patchu pihen vetole otan bammeil. umevi shenayim veshivim zugim uvahem shenayim veshivim inbolim hakkol zahav vetole bo shishsha usheloshim beshule kanaf ze veshishsha usheloshim beshule kanaf ze. vehazzug im hainbol hattaluy ben shenehem keechad nikra paamon ad sheyyihyu shulav mishshene tzedadav <small>(Shemot 39 26)</small> "paamon verimmon paamon verimmon":
Hazzahav shebbaarigat haefod vehachoshen haamur battora kacha hu maasehu. lokeach chut echad zahav tahor venotno im shishsha chutin shel techelet vechofel hashshiva chutin keachat. vechen hu ose chut zahav im shishsha shel argaman vechut echad im shishsha shel tolaat shani. vechut echad im shishsha shel pishtim. nimtzeu arbaa chute zahav venimtzeu kol hachutim shemona veesrim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 39 3)</small> "vayrakkeu et pache hazzahav" vegomer <small>(Shemot 39 3)</small> "laasot betoch hattechelet uvetoch haargaman uvetoch tolaat hashshani uvetoch hashshesh" melammed shechut hazzahav kaful betochan:
Ketzad maase hachoshen. oreg beged maase choshev min hazzahav vehattechelet vehaargaman vetolaat hashshani vehashshesh al shemona veesrim chutin kemo shebbearnu arko amma verachbo zeret vechoflo lishnayim. nimtza zeret al zeret merubba. vekovea bo arbaa turim shel even hameforashim battora kol even mehen merubba umeshukka bevayit shel zahav shemmakkifo millematta umearba ruchotav:
Umefatteach al haavanim shemot hashshevatim ketoldotam venimtza kotev al haodem reuven veal yashfe binyamin. vechotev battechilla lemala meruven avraham yitzchak veyaakov vechotev lematta mibbinyamin shivte yah kede sheyyihyu kol haotiyyot metzuyot sham:
Veose al arba zaviyyot shel choshen arba tabbeot zahav. venoten bishte hattabbaot shel mala shehachoshen nitle bahen shete avotot hazzahav. vehem hannikraim sharsherot. venoten bishte tabbaot shel matta shehen keneged haddadim shene petile techelet:
Haefod rachbo kerochav gabbo shel adam mikkatef lechatef. vearko mikkeneged atztzile hayyadayim meachorav ad haraglayim. veyesh lo kemo shete yadot yotzot mimmennu baarig lechan ulechan shechogrin oto bahem vehem hannikrain cheshev haefod. vehakkol arug zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh al shemona veesrim chutin kemaase hachoshen. vetofer alav shete ketefot kede sheyyihyu al kitfot hakkohen. vekovea al kol katef vechatef even shoham merubba mushka bevayit shel zahav. umefatteach al shete haavanim shemot hashshevatim. shishsha al even zo veshishsha al even zo ketoldotam. vechotvin shem yosef yehosef. venimtzeu 25 ot beeven zo vech ot beeven zo. vechach hayu ketuvin: vehaeven shekkatuv bah reuven al ketefo hayemanit. vehaeven shekkatuv bah shimon al ketefo hassemalit. veose bechol katef shete tabbaot achat millemala berosh hakkatef veachat millematta lakkatef lemala min hacheshev. venoten shete avotot zahav bishte tabbaot shellemala vehem hannikraim sharsherot:
Veachar kach machnis ketzot haavotot shel choshen battabbaot shel mala bechitfot haefod. umachnis shene petile hattechelet shebbeshule hachoshen bishte hattabbaot shel mala mecheshev haefod. umoridin et hashsharsherot shebbetabbeot kitfot haefod ad tabbeot hachoshen haelyonot kede sheyyiddavku ze baze <small>(Shemot 28 28)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 21)</small> "velo yizzach hachoshen meal haefod". vechol hammeziach choshen meal haefod umefarek chibburan derech kilkul loke: 
Nimtza keshellovesh haefod im hachoshen yihye hachoshen al libbo beshave vehaefod meacharav vecheshev haefod kashur al libbo tachat hachoshen. ushete kitfot haefod al shete ketefav. ushete avotot zahav yordot meal ketefav mikkan umikkan mikkitfot haefod ad tabbeot hachoshen. ushene chute techelet merukkasin mittachat atztzile yadav. mishshete tabbeot hachoshen hattachtonot ad shete tabbeot kitfot haefod hattachtonot shehem lemala min hacheshev:

Ketzad seder levishat habbegadim. lovesh hammichnasayim techilla vechoger et hammichnasayim lemala mittibburo meal matnav. veachar kach lovesh hakkuttonet. veachar kach choger et haavnet keneged atztzile yadav umakkifo kerech al kerech ad sheggomer vekosher:

Veal haavnet meforash bakkabbala <small>(Yechezkel 44 18)</small> "velo yachgeru bayyaza" bemakom shemmeziin. vechach kibbel yonatan ben uziel mippi hanneviim vetirgem al levavehon yesrun. veachar kach tzonef bammitznefet kemin kova:

Kohen gadol achar shechoger beavnet lovesh hammeil. veal hammeil haefod vehachoshen vechoger becheshev haefod al hammeil mittachat hachoshen ulefichach nikra <small>(Shemot 28 lo)</small> <small>(Shemot 29 5)</small> <small>(Shemot 39 22)</small> "meil haefod" shechogro baefod. veachar kach tzonef bammitznefet vekosher hatztzitz lemala min hammitznefet usearo haya nira ben tzitz lammitznefet vesham haya meniach tefillin ben tzitz lammitznefet:

Mitzvat ase laasot begadim ellu velihyot hakkohen oved bahen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 2)</small> "veasita vigde kodesh". <small>(Shemot 29 8)</small> "veet banav takriv vehilbashtam kuttonot". vechohen gadol sheshshimmesh befachot mishshemona begadim ellu o kohen hedyot sheshshimmesh befachot mearbaa begadim ellu hu hannikra mechussar begadim vaavodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim kezar sheshshimmesh shenneemar <small>(Shemot 29 9)</small> "vechagarta otam avnet" <small>(Shemot 29 9)</small> "vehayta lahem kehunna". bizman shebbigdehem alehen kehunnatan alehen. en bigdehen alehen en kehunnatam alehen ella hare hem kezarim veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 1 51)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 3 10)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 3 38)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 18 7)</small> "vehazzar hakkarev yumat":

Keshem shehammechussar begadim chayyav mita ufosel haavoda. kach hayyater begadim kegon shellavash shete kuttonot o shene avnetim o kohen hedyot shellavash bigde kohen gadol veavad hare ze mechallel haavoda vechayyav mita bide shamayim:

Neemar bevigde kehunna <small>(Vayikra 16 4)</small> "al besaro" <small>(Vayikra 16 4)</small> "ulevesham". melammed shello yihye davar chotzetz ben besaro labbegadim. afillu nima achat o afar o kinna meta im hayta ben basar labbeged hare zo chatzitza vaavodato pesula. lefichach en hakkohen yachol laavod bitfillin shel yad shehare chotzetzet. aval shel rosh enah chotzetzet. veim ratza lahanicham bishat haavoda meniach:

Vetzarich lehizzaher beshaa shellovesh shello yihye avak ben bigdo livsaro velo kinna af al pi shehi bachayyim. veshello tikkanes haruach bishat haavoda ben besaro levigdo ad sheyyitrachek habbeged mealav. velo yachnis yado tachat chaluko lachek. velo yetze searo min habbeged. velo yihye babbeged nima meduldelet. veim haya sham echad mikkol ellu avodato keshera:

Karach al besaro beged shello bimkom begadim kegon shekkeracho al etzbao o al akevo im haya bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot hare ze chotzetz ufosel. pachot mikkan eno chotzetz. veim haya tziltzul katan hoil vehu chashuv beged bifne atzmo hare ze posel veaf al pi sheen bo shalosh al shalosh:

Kohen shellaka beetzbao muttar lichroch aleha gemi beshabbat o beged sheen bo shalosh al shalosh veoved. veim nitkavven lehotzi dam asur. vehu shello yachotz haggemi o habbeged ben besaro lakkeli bishat avoda:

Asu bevayit sheni urim vetummim kede lehashelim shemona begadim veaf al pi shello hayu nishalin bahen. umippene ma lo hayu shoalin bahen mippene shello hayta sham ruach hakkodesh vechol kohen sheeno medabber beruach hakkodesh veen shechina shora alav en nishalin bo:

Vechetzad shoalin. omed hakkohen ufanav lifne haaron vehashshoel meacharav. panav leachare hakkohen. veomer hashshoel eele o lo eele. veeno shoel bekol ram velo mehareher belibbo ella bekol namuch kemi shemmitpallel beno leven atzmo. umiyyad ruach hakkodesh lovesh et hakkohen umabbit bachoshen veroe bo bemare hannevua ale o lo taale baotiyyot shebboltot min hachoshen keneged panav. vehakkohen meshivo veomer lo ale o lo taale:

Veen shoalin al shene devarim keechad. veim shaal meshivin al harishon bilvad. veen nishalin bahen lehedyot ella o lemelech o levet din o lemi shetztzorech hatztzibbur bo shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 27 21)</small> "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod vegomer. "hu" ze hammelech. "vechol bene yisrael" ze hu meshuach milchama o mi shetztzorech hatztzibbur bishelato. "vechol haeda" ellu bet din haggadol:

Ze sheatta motze bedivre neviim shehakkohanim hayu chogrin efod bad lo hayu kohanim gedolim. sheen haefod shel kohen gadol efod bad. veaf haleviyyim hayu chogrin oto shehare shemuel hannavi levi haya veneemar bo <small>(Shmuel 1 2 18)</small> "naar chagur efod bad". ella efod ze hayu chogrim oto bene hanneviim umi shehu rauy shettishre alav ruach hakkodesh lehodia ki higgia ze lemaalat kohen gadol shemmedabber al pi haefod vehachoshen beruach hakkodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Admission into the Sanctu:
Kol kohen hakkasher laavoda im shata yayin asur lo lehikkanes min hammizbeach ulefanim. veim nichnas veavad avodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 9)</small> "velo tamutu". vehu sheshshata reviit yayin chay bevat achat miyyayin sheavru alav arbaim yom. aval im shata pachot merviit yayin. o shata reviit vehifsik bah. o mezagah bemayim. o sheshshata yayin miggitto betoch arbaim afillu yeter merviit. patur veeno mechallel avoda. shata yeter merviit min hayyayin af al pi shehaya mazug veaf al pi shehifsik veshaha meat meat chayyav mita ufosel haavoda:
Haya shikkor mishshear mashkin hameshakkerin asur lehikkanes lammikdash veim nichnas veavad vehu shikkor mishshear mashkin hameshakkerin afillu min hechalav o min haddevela hare ze loke vaavodato keshera. sheen chayyavin mita ella al hayyayin bishat avoda. veen mechallel avoda ella shikkor min hayyayin:
Ucheshem sheasur lakkohen lehikkanes lammikdash mippene hashshichrut kach asur lechol adam ben kohen ben yisrael lehorot keshehu shatuy. afillu achal temarim o shata chalav venishtabbesha dato meat al yore shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 11)</small> "ulehorot et bene yisrael". veim hora bedavar shehu meforash battora ad sheyyedauhu hatztzedokim muttar kegon shehora shehashsheretz tame vehatztzefardea tahor vehaddam asur vechayyotze baze:
Umuttar leshikkor lelammed tora vaafillu halachot umidrashot vehu shello yore. veim haya chacham kavua lehoraa lo yelammed shellimmudo horaa hi:
Shata kede reviit bilvad vehaya bah mayim kol shehu. o yashan meat o halach kede mil. kevar avar hayyayin umuttar laavod. aval im shata yoter merviit afillu mazug. shenat meat o hadderech mosifin beshichruto. ella yishhe lefi hashshichrut ad shello yishshaer mishshichruto shum davar shebbaolam:
Anshe mishmar muttarin lishtot yayin ballelot aval lo bime shabbatan. vaafillu shear batte avot shel mishmar sheen avodatan hayyom. shemma tichbad haavoda al anshe bet av shel yom veyitztarchu laacherim meanshe mishmartan lesayyean. veanshe bet av shel oto hayyom asurim lishtot ben bayyom ben ballayla. shemma yishte ballayla veyashkim laavodato vaadayin lo sar yeno mealav:
Kol kohen sheyyodea mee ze mishmar hu umee ze bet av hu veyodea shebbatte avotav kevuim baavoda [hayyom] asur lo lishtot yayin kol oto hayyom. haya yodea mee ze mishmar hu veeno makkir bet av shello asur lo lishtot kol otah shabbat shemmishmarto ovdin bah. lo haya makkir mishmarto velo bet avotav haddin noten sheasur lishtot yayin leolam. aval takkanato kalkalato vahare hu muttar lishtot tamid sheeno yachol laavod ad sheyyikkava bevet av shello uvemishmarto:
Kohen sheggadal searo asur lo lehikkanes min hammizbeach velifnim veim nichnas veavad chayyav mita bide shamayim keshikkor sheavad. shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 44 21)</small> "veyayin lo yishtu kol kohen" <small>(Yechezkel 44 20)</small> "verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu". ma shetuye yayin bemita af meguddele pera bemita:
Veen perue harosh mechallelin avoda af al pi shehu bemita avodato keshera:
Keshem sheen hakkohanim muzharin al hayyayin ella bishat bia lammikdash kach en asurin legaddel pera ella bishat bia lammikdash. bamme devarim amurim bechohen hedyot. aval kohen gadol asur legaddel pera velikroa begadav leolam. shehare tamid hu bammikdash. ulechach neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 21 10)</small> "et rosho lo yifra uvegadav lo yifrom":
Kamma hu giddul pera. sheloshim yom kenazir shenneemar bo <small>(Bamidbar 6 5)</small> "gaddel pera sear rosho" veen nezirut pechuta mishsheloshim yom. lefichach kohen hedyot haoved megalleach mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom:
Veanshe mishmar asurin lesapper ulechabbes beshabbattan kede shello yaalu lemishmartan keshehen menuvvalin ella megallechin verochatzin umechabbesin kodem sheyyaalu:
Mi sheshshalma mishmarto betoch haregel muttar legalleach baregel. aval im shalma beerev haregel eno megalleach ella beerev haregel:
Din kerue begadim vedin perue rosh echad hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 6)</small> "rashechem lo tifrau uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu" ha im avad vehu kerua begadim chayyav mita bide shamayim af al pi sheavodato keshera velo chillelah: 
Yerae li shekkol kohen hakkasher laavoda im nichnas min hammizbeach velifnim vehu shetuy yayin o shikkor mishshear hameshakkerin o perua rosh o kerua begadim kederech shekkorin al hammetim af al pi shello avad avoda hare ze loke. hoil vehu rauy laavoda venichnas bishat haavoda menuvval kacha vahare hu muzhar shello yikkanes:
Vedin hannichnas kacha min hammizbeach velifnim vedin hayyotze mishsham echad hu. ketzad. kegon sheshshata reviit yayin ben haulam velammizbeach o kara begadav sham veyatza loke. vechen im avad bitziato chayyav mita:
Vechen asur lechol adam ben kohen ben yisrael lehikkanes lammikdash kullo mittechillat ezrat yisrael velifnim keshehu shetuy yayin o shikkor o perua rosh derech niuul o kerua begadim af al pi sheeno beazhara. sheen ze kavod umora labbayit haggadol vehakkadosh sheyyikkanes bo menuvval. aval yisrael sheggiddel searo ad shennaasa machlefet velo haya derech niuul hare ze muttar lehikkanes leezrat yisrael:

En kohen gadol nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim ella miyyom hakkippurim leyom hakkippurim. vechohen hedyot nichnas lakkodesh laavoda bechol yom:
Vehuzharu kol hakkohanim shello yikkansu lakkodesh o lekodesh hakkadashim shello bishat avoda shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh" ze kodesh hakkadashim <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "mibbet lapparochet" lehazehir al kol habbayit:
Kohen shennichnas lekodesh hakkadashim bishar yemot hashshana ben kohen hedyot ben kohen gadol o kohen gadol shennichnas lo beyom hakkippurim shello bishat haavoda chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "velo yamut". vechamma peamim hu nichnas lesham beyom hakkippurim arba kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. veim nichnas chamishit chayyav mita bide shamayim:
Vehannichnas lakkodesh chutz lekodesh hakkadashim shello laavoda o lehishtachavot ben hedyot ben gadol loke. veeno chayyav mita shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "el pene hakkapporet" <small>(Vayikra 16 2)</small> "velo yamut". al kodesh hakkadashim bemita veal shear habbayit belav veloke:
Kohen sheyyatza min hammikdash bishat haavoda bilvad chayyav mita ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedyot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 7)</small> "umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu pen tamutu". kelomar lo tanichu avoda vetetzu mevohalim udechufim mippene gezera zo. vechen ze shenneemar bechohen gadol <small>(Vayikra 21 12)</small> "umin hammikdash lo yetze" eno ella bishat haavoda bilvad shello yaniach avodato veyetze:
Im ken mippene ma nishnet azhara zo bechohen gadol. shekkohen hedyot shehaya bammikdash baavodato veshama shemmet lo met shehu chayyav lehitabbel alav af al pi sheeno yotze min hammikdash eno oved mippene shehu onen veim avad vehu onen shel tora chillel avodato ben bekarban yachid ben bekarban tzibbur. aval kohen gadol oved keshehu onen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 12)</small> "umin hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel" kelomar yeshev veyaavod avoda shehaya osek bah veenah mitchallelet:
Uminnayin sheavodat haonen pesula. mikkal vachomer. im baal mum sheochel bekadashim im avad chillel. onen shehu asur bekadashim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 26 14)</small> "lo achalti veoni mimmennu" din hu sheyyechallel:
Veaf al pi shekkohen gadol oved onen asur leechol bekadashim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 10 19)</small> "veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai". vechen eno cholek leechol baerev. onen sheavad eno loke. umuttar ligga bekadashim af al pi shello taval shello asu maala ella baachila aval bingia hare ze tahor kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
E zehu onen ze shemmet lo met min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen beyom hammita bilvad hu hannikra onen din tora. velayla hu onen middivre sofrim:
Umet sheshshaha yamim veachar kach nikbar kol otam hayyamim sheachar yom hammita hu onen middivrehem vechen yom hakkevura veeno tofes lelo. lefichach mi shemmet lo met (ukevaro) leachar yom hammita kol yom hakkevura eno makriv veeno ochel bekadashim middivrehem. vetovel veochel laerev. veyom shemua kerova veyom likkut atzamot hare hu keyom kevura sheeno tofes lelo vaafillu middivrehem. lefichach tovel veochel bekadashim laerev. aval yom hammita keshem sheasur leechol bo kadashim min hattora kach asur leechol belelo middivrehem. chutz min happesach bilvad shehu ochel laerev kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:
Haavel eno meshalleach karbenotav kol shiva. afillu yayin o etzim o levona. vechen metzora eno meshalleach karbenotav kol zeman sheeno rauy levia el hammachane eno rauy lehakerava. aval hamenudde yesh bo safek im meshalleach im eno meshalleach lefichach im hikrivu alav nirtza:
Teme sheretz vechayyotze bo vehearel meshallechin et karbenotehem umakrivin alehen chutz mippesach sheen shochatin oto al teme sheretz veen shochatin al hearel pesach kemo sheyyitbaer. aval teme met en makrivin alav karban kelal ad sheyyittaher:

Mitzvat ase leshalleach kol hattemeim min hammikdash shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 2)</small> "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh":
Ze hammachane haamur kan hu machane shechina shehu mippetach ezrat yisrael velifnim. shomea ani shehametzora vehazzav uteme met shelashtan bemakom echad. talmud lomar bimtzora <small>(Vayikra 13 46)</small> "badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo" ze machane yisrael shehu mippetach yerushalayim ulefanim. ma metzora shettumato chamura chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero. af kol shettumato chamura chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero. lefichach meshallechin et hametzora chutz lishlosha machanot shehu chutz lirushalayim. mippene shehu metamme bevia. ma sheen hazzav metamme:
Umeshallechin zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot chutz lishte machanot shehu chutz lehar habbayit. mippene shehen metammein hammishkav vehammoshav afillu mittachat haeven ma sheen hammet metamme:
Teme met afillu hammet atzmo muttar lehikkanes lehar habbayit shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 19)</small> "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo" immo bemachane halleviyya:
Hachel meshallechin mimmennu akkum utemee met uvoale niddot. aval tevul yom nichnas lesham shekkevar taval:
Ezrat hannashim meshallechin mimmennu tevul yom aval lo mechussar kippurim. shemmechussar kippurim heeriv shimsho. veasur tevul yom bemachane leviyya middivre sofrim:
Meezrat yisrael ulefanim afillu mechussar kippurim lo yikkanes lesham sheadayin lo tahar tohora gemura shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 8)</small> "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera" mikkelal sheadayin lo gamra tohoratah:
Hattame hameshullach mehar habbayit im nichnas over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 11)</small> "veyatza michutz lammachane" ze machane shechina <small>(Devarim 23 11)</small> "velo yavo el toch hammachane" ze machane leviyya. vechen metzora shennichnas lirushalayim loke. aval im nichnas lishar hearim hammukkafot choma af al pi sheeno rashshay lefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 13 46)</small> "badad yeshev" eno loke: 
Nichnas hametzora lehar habbayit loke shemonim. aval teme met o tevul yom shennichnas leezrat nashim o mechussar kippurim shennichnas leezrat yisrael af al pi sheeno loke makkin oto makkat mardut:
Ucheshem sheshshilluach temeim min hammikdash baase kach im nichnesu ovrim belo taase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 3)</small> "velo yetammeu et machanehem" ze machane shechina:
Uminnayin sheeno over ella im ken nichnas aval im naga baazara meachoreha patur shenneemar beyoledet <small>(Vayikra 12 4)</small> "veel hammikdash lo tavo":
Tame shennichnas lammikdash bemezid anush karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 16)</small> "veim lo yechabbes uvesaro lo yirchatz venasa avono". beshogeg mevi karban ole veyored shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 2)</small> "o nefesh asher tigga bechol davar tame". veen chayyavin karet o karban ella meezrat yisrael ulefanim o al tosefet haazara shennitkaddesha kedushsha gemura kemo shebbearnu:
Vee zehu hattame shechayyav karet al hammikdash kol shennitma betuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha shekkevar nitparesh binzirut. o sheyyigga baadam o bechelim shennitmeu beotan hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehem shehare hu sheni larishon shennaga bemet. o shennitma bishar avot hattumot shel tora sheyyitparshu bimkoman:
Kelalo shel davar kol hattaun biat mayim min hattora chayyav karet al biat hammikdash vaafillu achar shettaval ad sheyyaariv shimsho. aval hammittamme betumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen af al pi shehu tame tumat shiva hare ze patur al biat hammikdash:
Vechen hannogea bechelim shennagu beadam shennaga bemet o shennaga beadam shennaga bechelim hannogim bemet af al pi shehu tame rishon leinyan teruma uletamme besar kadashim hare ze patur al biat hammikdash. sheddevarim ellu halacha mippi hakkabbala. veaf al pi shehu patur makkin oto makkat mardut:
Hammachnis sheretz vechayyotze bo bammikdash o shehichnis adam tame lammikdash hare ze chayyav karet shehare timme mikdash Adonai. aval hazzorek kelim temeim lammikdash afillu hayu kelim shennagu bemet patur min hakkaret. aval chayyav malkot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 16)</small> "veim lo yechabbes" vegomer mippi hashshemua lamdu al rechitzat gufo anush karet veal kibbus begadav loke arbaim:
Yerae li sheeno loke ella al begadim shehen av tuma. kegon begadim shennaga bahen ze hattame lemet shehen av hattuma kemo sheyyitbaer. aval beged shehu rishon im hichniso lammikdash eno loke alav aval makkin oto makkat mardut:
Vechen tame shehichnis yado lammikdash makkin oto makkat mardut. vechen kol tame beav meavot hattumot shel divrehem o sheachal ochalin temeim veshata mashkin temein venichnas lammikdash bemezid kodem sheyyitbol makkin oto makkat mardut:
Tame shennichnas lammikdash derech gaggot patur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 4)</small> "veel hammikdash lo tavo" derech bia chiyyeva tora. veaf al pi shehu patur mikkaret makkin oto makkat mardut [vaafillu nichnas bemigdal happoreach baavir] ben shennichnas lammikdash [bemigdal] derech gaggot. ben shennichnas bo derech petachim:
Kol makom shechayyavim al zedono karet veal shiggato karban. im nimtzet sham tuma beshabbat motziin otah. ushear hammekomot kofin alav keli ad achar shabbat. ucheshehen motziin en motziin otah ella bifshute kele etz sheen mekabbel tuma shello lerabbot et hattuma:
Echad tame shennichnas lammikdash tahor. o tahor shennichnas lammikdash sheyyesh bo tuma. kegon shehaya met tachat ohel bammikdash venichnas hu tachat haohel. hare ze chayyav karet shehare biato vetuma bain keachat. nichnas lammikdash venitma sham achar shennichnas afillu timme atzmo sham bemezid yemaher veyibbahel veyetze bederech ketzara:
Veasur lo lishhot o lehishtachavot o latzet bederech arukka. veim shaha o sheyyatza baarukka af al pi shello shaha o shehechzir panav lahechol vehishtachava af al pi shello shaha chayyav karet. veim haya shogeg mevi karban:
Lo hechezir panav ella hishtachava derech yetziato kelappe chutz eno chayyav ella im ken shaha keshiur. vechamma shiur shehiyyato kede likrot <small>(divrei hayamim 2 7 3)</small> "veyichreu appayim artza al haritzpa veyishtachavu vehodot laAdonai ki tov ki leolam chasdo". vezehu shiur hishtachavaya:
Vee zo hi derech arukka. kol sheefshar lo latzet min hammikdash bederech ketzara mimmenna. yatza biktzara af al pi shello ratz ella halach akev betzad gudal afillu kol hayyom patur. yatza baarukka af al pi sheratz vedachak atzmo bechol kocho venimtza shiur zeman shehalach bo haarukka pachot mishshiur hazzeman shemmehallech kol adam biktzara hoil veyatza baarukka chayyav. yatza biktzara vehalach meat veamad veshaha meat ad shennitztaref mikkol hashshehiyyot kede hishtachavaya bemezid eno loke beshogeg eno mevi karban mippene shehaddavar safek. aval makkin oto makkat mardut:

Tame sheavad bammikdash chillel avodato vechayyav mita bide shamayim al avodato af al pi shello shaha sham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 2)</small> "veyinnazru mikkadshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem kadshi" hare zo azhara leoved betuma. ulehallan hu omer <small>(Vayikra 22 9)</small> "umetu vo ki yechalleluhu". ma chillul haamur [sham] chayyav mita bide shamayim af kan mita bide shamayim. vechol lav shechayyavin alav mita bide shamayim lokin alav:
Af al pi sheim avad betuma eno chayyav bevet din ella malkot echav hakkohanim lo hayu meviin oto levet din ella motziin oto lachutz ufotzin et mocho veen memachin alehen bechach:

Veheach efshar lo laavod velo yishhe ad shello yitchayyev karet ella mita bide shamayim bilvad. kegon shennitma baazara veyatza biktzara uvitziato haya tzinnor beyado vehafach bo evar al haesh bammizbeach vekerev serefato shekkol keruv avoda hare hu kaavoda:

Vechen tame shettaval veavad kodem sheyyaariv shimsho avodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 6)</small> "velo yechallelu shem elohehem". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara litvul yom sheavad sheadayin tame hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 7)</small> "uva hashshemesh vetaher" mikkelal sheadayin lo taher. aval mechussar kippurim sheavad af al pi sheavodato pesula vechillel hare ze patur:
Uminnayin sheavodato pesula shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 8)</small> "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera". mikkelal sheadayin lo nigmera tohoratah. vehu haddin lechol mechussere kippurim:

Kohen sheavad veachar kach noda shehaya tame. im hi tuma yedua kol hakkarbanot shehikriv pesulin shehare avodato chullin. veim hi tumat hattehom hatztzitz meratztze. vechol hakkarbanot shehikriv nirtzu. vaafillu noda lo shehu tame kodem sheyyizrok haddam vezarak hurtza. shehatztzitz meratztze al tumat hattehom af al pi shehu mezid. uchevar bearnu tumat hattehom binzirut:

Vechen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat devarim hakkerevin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 38)</small> "vehaya al metzach aharon venasa aharon et avon hakodashim". aval eno meratztze al tumat hanneechalin. velo al tumat haadam shennitma betuma yedua. ella im ken hayta hattuma haddechuya batztzibbur shehatztzitz meratztze aleha:
Veen hatztzitz meratztze ella bizman shehu al mitzcho shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 38)</small> "vehaya al mitzcho tamid leratzon lahem lifne Adonai":

Kol karban sheen kavua lo zeman eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma. sheim lo yakriv hayyom yikkarev lemachar ulemochorat machar. vechol karban shekkavua lo zeman ben karban tzibbur ben karban yachid doche et hashshabbat vedoche et hattuma. velo kol hattumot hu doche ella tumat hammet levaddah:
Kol karbenot hatztzibbur kavua zemannam. lefichach kullan dochin et hashshabbat veet tumat hammet:
Vechol karban mehen shekkarev betuma eno neechol. ella maktirin mimmennu devarim haruyin lehaketara vehashshear harauy laachila nisraf kishar kadashim shennitmeu:

Ketzad doche et hattuma. higgia zemanno shel oto karban vehayu rov hakkahal shemmakrivin oto temein lemet. o shehayu hakkahal tehorim vehayu hakkohanim hammakrivin temeim lemet. o shehayu ellu veellu tehorin vehayu kele hashsharet temeim lemet. hare ze yease betuma veyitasseku bo hattemeim vehattehorim keechad veyikkansu kullan laazara. aval hattemeim betuma acheret kegon zavin vezavot veniddot [veyoldot] utemee sheretz unevela vechayyotze bahen. lo yitasseku velo yikkansu laazara veaf al pi shennaasa betuma. veim avru veasu o nichnesu laazara chayyavin karet al habbia umita al haavoda. shello nidchet ella tumat hammet bilvad:

Ufesach shebba betuma vedachaku temee met venichnesu lahechol peturin. af al pi shello hutteru ella laazara. hoil veen ani kore bahem <small>(Bamidbar 5 3)</small> "el michutz lammachane teshallechum" hare ellu peturin:

Hayu miktzat bet av temeim umiktzatam tehorim af al pi sherubban temee met lo yakrivu ella hattehorim. haya kol bet haav temee met yaviu bet av acher. hayta kol hammishmara temee met machazirin al mishmara acheret. im hayu rov hakkohanim hannichnasin sham birushalayim bazzeman hakkavua temein yaasu betuma:

Umippene ma machazirin al hattahor mibbet av acher. mippene shehattuma lo huttera batztzibbur ella beissurah omedet udechuya hi atta mippene haddechak. veen dochin kol davar hannidche ella bemakom shei efshar. umippene ze tzericha tzitz leratztzot aleha:

Uminnayin shettumat met dechuya batztzibbur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 9 6)</small> "vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam". kach lamdu mippi hashshemua sheanashim yechidim hem sheyyiddachu lefesach sheni im hayu temeim. aval tzibbur shehayu temee met enan nidchin ella hattuma tiddache veyaasu pesach betuma. vehu haddin lechol karban shekkavua lo zeman kefesach shehu doche et hattuma:

Vahare haddavar meforash bakketuvim shenneemar sham <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 17)</small> "ki rabbat bakkahal asher lo hitkaddashu vehaleviyyim al shechitat happesachim lechol lo tahor" [lehakedish laAdonai] <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 18)</small> "ki marbit haam rabbat meefrayim umenashshe yissashchar uzevulun lo hitteharu". umahu ze shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 18)</small> "ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv" mippene sheibberu otah hashshana mippene hattuma shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 2)</small> "vayyivvaatz hammelech vesarav vechol hakkahal birushalami laasot happesach bachodesh hashsheni" <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 3)</small> "ki lo yachlu laasoto baet hahi ki hakkohanim lo hitkaddeshu lemadday". uchevar bearnu bekiddush hachodesh sheen meabberin et hashshana lechattechilla mippene hattuma:

Veod acheret hayta sham beotah hashshana. sheibber chizkiyya hammelech et hashshana beyom sheloshim shel adar sherauy lihyot rosh chodesh nisan veasa oto hachodesh adar sheni velo hodu lo chachamim sheen meabberin beyom ze kemo shebbearnu bekiddush hachodesh. umippene devarim ellu sheasa shello kahalacha neemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 18)</small> "ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv". uvikkesh rachamim al atzmo veal hachachamim shehiskimu al maasav shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 18)</small> "ki hitpallel yechizkiyyahu alehem lemor Adonai hattov yechapper bead" veneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 30 20)</small> "vayyishma Adonai el yechizkiyyahu vayyirpa et haam" shennirtza karbanam:

Mitzvat ase lekaddesh kohen haoved yadav veraglav veachar kach yaavod shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 19)</small> "verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu et yedehem veet raglehem". vechohen sheavad velo kiddesh yadav veraglav shacharit chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 20)</small> "yirchatzu mayim velo yamutu". vaavodato pesula ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedyot:

Uminnayin sheavodato pesula shenneemar <small>(Shemot 28 43)</small> "chukkat olam lo ulezaro". uvevigde kehunna hu omer chukkat olam. ma mechussar begadim mechallel avoda kemo shebbearnu. af mi shello rachatz yadav veraglav mechallel avoda:

En hakkohen tzarich lekaddesh ben kol avoda vaavoda. ella paam achat mekaddesh babboker veoved veholech kol hayyom kullo vechol hallayla. vehu shello yetze min hammikdash velo yishan velo yatil mayim velo yassiach dato. veim asa echad mearbatan tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh:
Yatza min hammikdash vechazar veavad velo kiddesh im lo hissiach dato avodato keshera. veze hakkelal haya bammikdash en adam nichnas laazara laavoda af al pi shehu tahor ad shehu tovel:

Vechol hammesich et raglav taun tevila. vechol hammetil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim. yatza chutz lechomat haazara im lishhot bachutz yatza keshechozer taun tevila veim lachzor miyyad yatza] keshechozer taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim bilvad. veim lo taval velo kiddesh veavad hoil velo hissiach dato velo hissich raglav velo hetil mayim avodato keshera. hotzi yadav chutz lechomat haazara eno tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh:

Nitmeu yadav matbilan vehen tehorot. veeno tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh. nitma gufo baachilat ochalin temein o shetiyyat mashkin temein vetaval af al pi sheeno tzarich haarev shemesh chozer umekaddesh achar tevila. shekkol tovel mekaddesh yadav veraglav veachar kach oved. veim lo kiddesh hoil velo hissiach dato lo chillel:

Kohen gadol shello taval velo kiddesh yadav veraglav ben begadim livgadim uven avoda laavoda beyom hakkippurim veavad avodato keshera. hoil veotan hattevilot vehakkiddushin enan shavim beaharon uvanav veneemar <small>(Shemot 30 19)</small> "verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu" davar hashshave bechol hakkohanim meakkev shehu kiddush rishon:

Kiddesh yadav hayyom tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh lemachar af al pi shello yashan kol hallayla. shehayyadayim nifsalot belina. kiddesh ballayla vehiktir hachalavim kol hallayla tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh bayyom laavodat hayyom:
Kiddesh yadav veraglav litrumat haddeshen af al pi shehu mekaddesh kodem shettaale hashshemesh eno tzarich lachzor ulekaddesh achar sheheir hayyom shehare bitchillat avoda kiddesh:

Mitzva lekaddesh mimme hakkiyyor veim kiddesh meechad mikkele hashsharet hare ze kasher. aval kele hachol enam mekaddeshin. kiddesh bichli sharet bachutz o bichli chol bifnim veavad avodato pesula. veen mekaddeshin betoch hakkiyyor o betoch kele hashsharet ella mehen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 19)</small> "verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu" velo betocho. veim kiddesh betocho veavad lo chillel:
Hitbil yadav veraglav beme mikve afillu bemayan en ze kiddush kelal ad sheyyirchatz bichli. uvechol kele hakkodesh mekaddeshin ben sheyyesh bahen reviit ben sheen bahen reviit:

Kol hammemot kesherim lekiddush ben mayim chayyim ben me mikve. uvilvad shello yishtanne marehen. ella yihyu kammayim hakkesherim litvila. tit hannarok shehappara shocha veshota mimmennu mashlim leme kiyyor. ze hakkelal kol hammashlim leme mikve mashlim leme kiyyor:
Kamma mayim tzerichin lihyot bakkiyyor en pachot mikkede lekaddesh mimmennu arbaa kohanim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 30 19)</small> "aharon uvanav" vehayu elazar veitamar ufinchas immahem hare arbaa:
Me kiyyor nifsalin belina kemo shebbearnu. vechetzad hayu osin. meshakkeim oto beme mikve o bemayan ulemachar maalin oto o memallein oto bechol yom babboker:
Hayyam sheasa shelomo kemikve haya. mippene sheamma shel mayim hayta overet betocho meen etam. lefichach lo hayu memav nifsalin belina keme hakkiyyor umimmennu hayu memallein hakkiyyor:

Ketzad mitzvat kiddush. manniach yado hayemanit al gabbe raglo hayemanit veyado hassemalit al gabbe raglo hassemalit veshoche umekaddesh. vechol hachotzetz bitvila chotzetz bekiddush yadayim. veeno mekaddesh keshehu yoshev mippene shehu kaavoda. veen avoda ella meummad shenneemar <small>(Devarim 18 5)</small> "laamod lesharet":

Vechol haoved vehu yoshev chillel vaavodato pesula veeno loke. mippene sheazhara shello mikkelal ase hi. vechen kol haosek baavoda meavodat hammikdash tzarich sheyyihye omed al haritzpa. veim haya davar chotzetz beno uven hakkarka kegon sheamad al gabbe kelim o behema o al ragle chavero pasal. vechen im haya davar chotzetz ben yado uven hakkeli sheoved bo pasal:

Veen avoda ella beyamin. veim avad bismol pesula veeno loke. raglo achat al hakkeli veraglo achat al haritzpa [raglo achat al haeven veraglo achat al haritzpa] roin kol sheillu yinnatel hakkeli o haeven yachol laamod al raglo achat avodato keshera. veim lav avodato pesula. kibbel beyamin usemol mesayyato avodato keshera. shehamesayyea en mashgichin alav:
Nitnaddeda even meavne haazara lo yaamod aleha bishat avoda ad shettechubbar baaretz. veim avad avodato keshera hoil uvimkomah omedet:

Kol kohen sheyyesh bo mum ben mum kavua ben mum over lo yikkanes lammikdash min hammizbeach ulefanim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 23)</small> "el happarochet lo yavo veel hammizbeach lo yiggash". veim avar venichnas loke af al pi shello avad. veim avad bammikdash pasal vechillel avoda veloke af al haavoda. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 17)</small> "asher yihye vo mum lo yikrav". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheazhara zo shello yikrav laavoda:
Vechen baal mum over sheavad pasal veloke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 18)</small> "chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara levaal mum over. veen baale mumin sheavdu bemita ella bemalkot bilvad:
Kol hammumin kullan echad shehayu bo mittechillat beriyyato veechad shennoldu bo achar ken ben ovrin ben sheenan ovrin hare ze pasul ad sheyyaavoru:
Mum kavua kegon shever regel o shever yad. umum over kegon garav o yallefet vehi hachazazit. velo hammumin hakketuvin battora bilvad hen sheppesulin bechohanim ella kol hammumin hannirin bagguf shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 18)</small> <small>(Vayikra 21 21)</small> "kol asher bo mum" mikkol makom. veellu hakketuvim battora dugma hen: 
Shelosha mine mumin hem. yesh mumin shehen poslin hakkohen millaavod vehabbehema millikkarev. [veyesh mumin shepposlin baadam bilvad millaavod]. veyesh mumin sheen poslin aval mippene marit haayin amru shekkol kohen sheyyesh bo echad mehen eno oved:
Kol mi sheyyesh bo mum shepposel baadam uvabbehema veavad ben beshogeg ben bemezid avodato pesula. veim haya mezid loke. vechol mi sheyyesh bo mum min hammumin hameyuchadin laadam veavad af al pi shehu loke lo chillel avodato. veim haya bo davar middevarim shehem mippene marit haayin eno loke vaavodato keshera:
En posel baadam ella mumin shebbegaluy. aval mumin shebbachalal hagguf kegon shennittal kulyato shel adam o techol shello o shennikkevu meav af al pi shennaasa terefa avodato keshera shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 19)</small> "shever ragel o shever yad" ma ellu begaluy af kol begaluy:
Hearel hare hu keven nechar shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 44 9)</small> "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar". lefichach arel sheavad chillel avodato veloke kezar sheavad. aval eno chayyav mita:
Kohen shehaya nose nashim baavera eno oved ad sheyyaddiruhu bet din al daat rabbim kede shello yihye lo hafara shello yosif lachato veoved veyored umegaresh. vechen im haya mittamme lemetim pasul ad sheyyekabbel alav bevet din shello yittamme. veim avar veavad kodem sheyyaddir o sheyyekabbel af al pi shehu nasuy baavera lo chillel avoda:
Kohen sheavad venivdak venimtza chalal avodato keshera lesheavar veeno oved lehabba. veim avad lo chillel shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33 11)</small> "barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze" af chullin shebbo tirtze:
Bet din haggadol hayu yoshvin belishkat haggazit. veikkar maasehem hattadir shehayu yoshvin vedanin et hakkehunna uvodkin hakkohanim beyuchasin uvemumin. kol kohen shennimtza pasul beyichuso lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim veyotze min haazara. vechol mi shennimtza shalem vechasher lovesh levanim venichnas umeshammesh im echav hakkohanim:
Mi shennimtza kasher beyichuso venimtza bo mum. yoshev belishkat haetzim umetallea etzim lammaaracha vecholek bekadashim im anshe bet av shello veochel shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 22)</small> "lechem elohav mikkadshe hakkadashim umin hakkadashim yochel":
Kol hammumin happoslim baadam uvabbehema chamishshim vezehu peratan:
Chamishsha baozen. veellu hen. mi shennifgam sechus azno kede shettachgor hatztzipporen bappegam. aval haor hammukkaf lischus haozen en bo mum ben nikkav ben nisdak:

Mi shennisdak sechus azno bechol shehu af al pi shello chaser. mi shennikkav sechus azno kecharshina ben nekev agol ben nekev aroch im mitztaref lecharshina hare ze mum. mi sheyyavsha azno kede shettinnakev velo totzi dam. mi shehayta azno kefula lishtayim. afillu haggedi shedderech aznav lihyotan notot uchefulot uvilvad sheyyihyu lo shene sechusin. aval im en lah ella sechus echad vahare hu keguf echad shennichpal kasher:

Shelosha beris shel ayin veellu hen. mi shennikkav ris merise enav bechol shehu. mi shennisdak ris merise enav bechol shehu. [mi shennifgam ris merise enav bechol shehu]. ushelosha mumin ellu bichlal <small>(Vayikra 22 22)</small> "charutz" haamur battora:

Shemona baayin veellu hen. haivver ben beechad meenav ben mishshetehen. mi sheeno roe bishte enav o beachat mehen. af al pi sheen nira bahen shinnuy kelal mechamat sheyyardu mayim kevuim keneged rootav. mi sheeno roe beenav o beachat mehen reiyya berura mechamat shehaya bah sanverim kevuim. mi shebbeeno kemo enav af al pi shehu roe. mi sheyyatza basar yater beeno ad shechippa meat min hashshachor shel ayin. mi shennimshach halloven shel ayin venichnas mimmennu meat bashshachor ad shennimtza hashshachor meorav balloven vehu <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> "tevallul" haamur battora. aval im yatza min hashshachor letoch hallavan eno mum sheen mumin belavan. mi shehayta nekudda levana betoch hashshachor vezehu <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> "dak" haamur battora vehu shettihye tzafa al gabbe hashshachor. aval im lo hayta tzafa o shehayta meshukkaat beshachor eno mum. vechen im hayta nekudda shechora betoch halloven afillu tzafa eno mum sheen mumim belavan. hayta nekudda shechora shokaat betoch hashshachor af ze nikra dak. aval im hayta tzafa hoil vehi shechora beshachor eno mum:
Shelosha bachotem. veellu hen. mi shennikkav chatmo afillu mitztzad echad. mi shennisdak chatmo. mi shennifgam chatmo:

Shishsha bappe. veellu hen. mi shennikkav sefato afillu achat mehen. mi shennifgema sefato. mi shennisdeka sefato vehu shennisdak mizzer shellah ad shettechalek lishne rashim. mi sheetzem lechyo hattachton odef al haelyon kol shehu. mi sheppiv nivlam mechamat gufo uveriyyato. aval im nivlam mechamat haruach eno mum. mi shennittal rov hamedabber shel leshono:

Shenem asar beevre hazzera veellu hen. mi shennimach haggid shello. o nichtat. o nittak. o nichrat. mi shennimachu habbetzim shello o achat mehen. o nichtetu o achat mehen. o nitteku o achat mehen. o nichretu o achat mehen. mi sheen lo ella betza achat af al pi sheyyesh lo shene kisin. mi sheshshete betzav bechis echad. hattumtum. haanderoginus:

Shishsha bayyadayim uvaraglayim veellu hen. happisseach. umi shennishmeta yerecho hu <small>(Vayikra 21 18)</small> <small>(Vayikra 22 23)</small> "sarua" haamur battora. mi sheachat miyyarchotav gevoha mechavertah. mi shennishbar etzem yado vehu sheyyihye nikkar. mi shennishbar etzem raglo vehu sheyyihye nikkar. af al pi sheeno nikkar kesheomed im nikkar kesheyyehallech hare ze mum. mi sheraglav mevullamot mechamat atzman uveriyyatan. aval im hayu mevullamot mechamat haruach eno mum:

Arbaa reuyin lihyot bechol hagguf veellu hen. mi sheyyesh bo garav yavesh kol shehu vezehu ha <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> <small>(Vayikra 22 22)</small> "garav" haamur battora. mi sheyyesh bo yabbelet sheyyesh bah etzem veze hu <small>(Vayikra 22 22)</small> "yabbelet" haamura battora. mi sheyyesh bo chazazit mitzrit kol shehi vehi chazazit kasha ucheura vezo hu <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> <small>(Vayikra 22 22)</small> "yallefet" haamura battora:
Kol etzem shebbegaluy shennechratz bo charitz hare ze mum vehu bichlal <small>(Vayikra 22 22)</small> "charutz" haamura battora. veen hatztzelaot bichlal atzamot shebbegaluy:

Veod yesh sham shelosha mumin acherim veellu hen. hazzaken shehiggia lihyot rotet veroed keshehu omed. hachole keshehu roed mippene chalyo vechishlon kocho. aval hatterefa kasher baadam ufasul bivhema. vechen yotze dofen kasher baadam ufasul bivhema:

Hamezoham vechohen shehu mezoham bezeato rochetz veshaf kol gufo bevoshom veoved. haya reach piv ra noten befiv pilpel o zangevil vechayyotze bahen veoved. veim avad bezihum zeato o bezihum piv hare chillel avodato kishar ellu habbaale mumin kullam:

Kol hammumin hameyuchadin baadam tishim vezehu peratan. shemona barosh veellu hen. mi sheemtza kadkodo shokea lematta kemo sheddechako beyado. mi sheemtza kadkodo ole lemala kemo betza. mi sheppeat rosho yotze keneged panav kemo makkevet. mi sherosho yotze meachorav keneged arpo. mi sherosho rachav veyotze mikkan umikkan ad shettimtza rosho al tzavvaro kemo rosh hallefet al healin shello. hakkereach sheen bechol rosho sear kol ikkar. veim yesh bo shita shel sear mukkefet meachorav meozen leozen kasher. mi shehaya hassear makkif meozen leozen millefanav bilvad ushear harosh kereach hu hare hu pasul. mi shehaya hassear shello makkif et kol harosh saviv millefanav umeacharav veen sham sear beemtza gam ze kereach ufasul:
Shenayim batztzavvar veellu hem. mi shetztzavvaro shokea harebe ad shennimtza rosho keillu hu munnach al ketefav. mi shetztzavvaro aroch harebe ad shennire keshamut mibben ketefav:
Arbaa baozen veellu hen. mi sheshshete aznav ketannot harebe. mi sheshshete aznav nefuchot domot lisfog. mi sheaznav meduldalot lematta. mi sheachat meaznav meshunna mechavertah bemareha:
Chamishsha baggevinim veellu hen. mi sheen lo sear bigvinav vehu <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> "gibben" haamur battora. mi sheggevinav shochvin. mi sheen lo ella gavin echad. mi sheyyesh lo gevinin yeter al shenayim. mi sheechad miggevinav meshunne mechavero ben shessearo shel ze aroch usearo shel ze katzar ben shessearo shel echad shachor usearo hashsheni lavan o adom hoil veyesh benehem shinnuy ze hare ze pasul:
Arbaa beris haayin veellu hen. mi sheen lo sear kelal berise enav. mi shessear rise enav merubbe meubbe harebe. mi shessear echad merise enav meshunne missear ris acher kegon sheechad shachor veechad lavan o sheechad nosher vehashsheni meubbe. mi sheafappav segurot meat veenan niftachot harebe kishar kol haadam:
Achad asar baenayim veellu hen. mi shehayu shete enav lemala min hammakom harauy lahem kerovot mippaddachto. mi shehayu shete enav lematta mimmakom harauy lahem. mi shehayu shete enav agulot veenam nimshachot baorech meat mishshear haenayim. mi sheenav muzarot vehen yotzot keene hannamer uchemi shehu mistakkel beet shekkoes kaas harebe. mi sheenav gedolot harebe keshel egel. mi sheenav ketannot keshel avvaz. mi sheddemaav zolfot tamid. mi shellachluchit nimshechet merosh eno mikkeneged hachotem o mizzenav eno mitztzad tzedaav. mi shemmekabbetz rise enav veotzman meat beshaa sheroe or o beshaa shehu rotze ledakdek biriyya. mi sheriyyat eno meurbevet ad sheroe et hacheder veet haaliyya keachat. veyivvada davar ze beet sheyyedabber im chavero venire keillu hu mistakkel beish acher. mi sheachat meenav meshunna mechavertah ben bimkomah ben bemareha kegon shehayta achat shechora veachat petucha o achat ketanna veachat gedola hoil veyesh ben shetehen shinnuy mikkol makom pasul:
Shishsha bachotem veellu hen. mi sheikkar chatmo shokea af al pi sheeno kochel shete enav keachat veze <small>(Vayikra 21 18)</small> "charum" haamur battora. mi sheemtza chatmo bolet lemala. mi sheoketz chatmo notef lematta. mi shechatmo akom letzad echad. mi shechatmo gadol meevarav. mi shechatmo katan meevarav. vechetzad meshaarin oto. beetzba ketanna sheal yado. im haya chatmo gadol mimmenna o katan mimmenna hare ze mum:
Shelosha bassefatayim veellu hen. mi shessefato haelyona odefet al hattachtona. mi shessefato hattachtona odefet al haelyona. mi sheppiv rafuy veriro yored mippiv:
Shelosha babbeten veellu hen. mi shekkereso tzava [1.] mi shettibburo yotze veeno shokea kishar bene adam. mi sheddadav shochvin al bitno kedade ishsha:
Shelosha baggav veellu hen. mi sheshshidrato akumma. mi sheyyatzata chulya mishshidrato ben shebbalta lachutz o nichnesa lifnim o natta latztzedadin vezehu baal chatoteret. mi shettafach basar begabbo venaasa kachatoteret af al pi shello zaza chuleya mimmekomah hare ze mum:
Shishsha bayyadayim veellu hen. mi sheyyesh beyado etzba yetera beetzbeot yadav afillu hayu shesh veshesh. veim chatach et hayetera kasher. veim haya bah etzem afillu chatachah pasul. mi shechaser etzba miyyado. mi sheshshete etzbeot yadav kelutot ad lematta min happerek. veim chatachan vehifrishan ad happerek kasher. beeze perek amru beferek rishon hassamuch lechaf hayyad. mi sheetzbeotav murkavot zo al gabbe zo. mi sheppika yotzet miggudalo. mi shehu itter yad yemino. veim haya sholet bishte yadav kasher:
Arbaa beevre hazzara veellu hen. mi shekkis habbetzim gadol vearoch ad shemmaggia learkubbotav. mi shehaggid shello aroch ad shemmaggia learkuvotav. mi shennimrechu ashachav vehem hakkis shel betzim. [mi sheruach baashachav] vehu <small>(Vayikra 21 20)</small> "meroach ashech" haamur battora:
Chamishsha asar bashshokayim uvaraglayim veellu hen. mi sheshshokav akummot ad shemmechabber regel leregel veen arkubbotav nogot zo bezo. mi sheppikato yotzet vehappika hi haetzem heagol shellemala min heakev mitztzad penim vehu dome lefika shettovot bah hannashim. mi sheakevo yotze laachorav ad shennimtza hashshok keillu hu beemtza raglo omed. mi shepparsotav rechavot keshel avvaz af al pi sheenan kelutot keshel avvaz. mi sheppika yotza miggudalo. mi sheyyesh beraglo etzba yetera afillu shesh veshesh. veim chatachah kasher vehu shello yihye bah etzem. mi shechaser achat meetzbeot raglav. mi sheetzbeotav murkavot zo al gabbe zo. mi shehayu etzbeot raglav kelutot ad lematta min happerek. veim hayu ad happerek o shechatachan vehifrishan kasher. mi sheraglo kullah shava shennimtza rochav pas etzbeotav kerochav akevo ucheillu hi chaticha shava. mi sheraglo akuma doma lemaggal shennimtza pas raglo sheyyesh bo haetzbaot im akevo keillu hem shene rashe hakkeshet. mi sheraglo chalula vehu sheyyihye emtzaah gavoah meal haaretz venimtza kesheomed omed al akevo veal etzbeot raglav. hammakkish bekarsullav beet shemmehallech. mi shemmakkish bearkubbotav beet shemmehallech. mi shehu itter beregel yemino:
Arbaa bechol hagguf veellu hen. mi sheggufo gadol meevarav. mi sheggufo katan meevarav. haaroch beyoter. hannannas vehu hakkatzar beyoter ad sheyyihyu muflagin mishshear haam:
Shemona beor habbasar veellu hen. hakkushi. hallavan beyoter kemo gevina. haadom keshani. baale negaim tehorim shennishtanna haor mechamat atzmo kemo habbohak. shennishtanna haor mechamat davar acher kegon tzarevet hammichva veze bichlal negaim tehorin. mi shehayta beor panav shuma sheyyesh bah sear af al pi sheenah keissar ella kol shehu. mi shehayta beor panav shuma keissar o yoter. baale haddildulin vehu sheyyiddaldel haor vehabbasar o hallachluchit sheyyesh baor shenniddaldel bee ze makom sheyyihye mikkol hagguf hare ze mum:
Veod yesh sham baadam arbaa mumin acherim veellu hen. hacheresh. hashshote. vehannichpe afillu leyamim rabbim. mi sheruach raa mevaatteto tamid o beittim yeduim:
Nimtzeu kol hammumin happoslin bechohanim mea vearbaim vezehu kelalam. shemona barosh. ushenayim batztzavvar. vetisha baaznayim. vachamishsha baggevinim. veshiva beris haayin. vetisha asar baenayim. vetisha bachotem. vetisha bappe. ushelosha babbeten. ushelosha baggav. veshiva bayyadayim. veshishsha asar beevre hazzera. veesrim baraglayim. ushemona bechol hagguf. ushemona beor habbasar. veshiva bechoach hagguf verecho. uchevar nifretu kullan echad echad. veellu paslu mippene marit haayin. mi shennashru rise enav af al pi shennishar hassear beikkaran. umi shennittelu shinnav:

Zar sheavad bammikdash avodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 7)</small> "vehazzar hakkarev yumat" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen chiyyuv ze ella likrav laavoda. vehechan hizhir alav vezar lo yikrav alechem. e zehu zar kol sheeno mizzera aharon hazzecharim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 8)</small> "vearchu bene aharon". vehiktiru bene aharon. bene aharon velo benot aharon:

Af al pi shehazzarim muzharin shello yitasseku baavoda meavodot hakkarbanot en chayyavin mita ella al avoda tamma lo al avoda sheyyesh achareha avoda. veen hazzar chayyav mita ella al arba avodot bilvad. al hazzerika veal hahaktara veal nissuch hammayim bechag veal nissuch hayyayin tamid:
Ketzad al hazzerika. ben shezzarak bifnim ben shezzarak bachutz ben shehizza hazzaa achat mikkol hazzayot haddam ben shehizza hazzaa achat mikkol hazzayot karbenot hametzora hare ze chayyav mita:
