Ketzad al haketara. hiktir evarim o kometz o levona al hammizbeach afillu hafach baevarim shello nitakkelu vekerev serefatan chayyav mita vehu shehiktir kezayit. vechen im hiktir ketoret al mizbach hazzahav mishsheyyaktir kezayit chayyav. aval hammaktir ketoret beyom hakkippurim bekodesh hakkadashim eno chayyav mita aleha ad sheyyaktir melo chafnav shiur hameforash battora:

Vehamesadder shene gizre etzim al hammaaracha hare hu kemaktir evarim vechayyav mita shehaetzim karban hu. aval hayyotzek vehabbolel vehappotet vehammoleach vehammenif vehammaggish umesadder et lechem happanim o et habbezichin al hashshulchan vehammetiv et hannerot vehammatztzit esh bammizbeach vehakkometz vehamekabbel damim. af al pi shennifselu vahare hu muzhar al kol ellu veloke eno chayyav mita. mippene shekkol achat mehen avoda sheachareha avoda veenah gemar avoda:

Shechitat hakkadashim keshera bezarim afillu kadshe kadashim. ben kadshe yachid ben kadshe tzibbur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 5)</small> "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu bene aharon" mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna. vechen hahefshet vehannittuach veholachat etzim lammizbeach keshera bezarim shenneemar baevarim <small>(Vayikra 1 9)</small> "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" zo holachat evarim lakkevesh. holachat evarim hi shetztzericha kehunna velo holachat etzim:
Vechen hadelakat hannerot keshera bezarim lefichach im hetiv hakkohen et hannerot vehotzian lachutz muttar lezar lehadelikan:

Haramat haddeshen tzericha kohen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 3)</small> "velavash hakkohen middo vad" vegomer. veim herim yisrael loke veeno chayyav mita af al pi sheen achareha avoda shenneemar avodat mattana <small>(Bamidbar 18 7)</small> "avodat mattana" hu shettihye bechohen levaddo veim karav lah hazzar chayyav mita. aval avodat silluk en chayyavin aleha mita. [vechen im dishshen mizbeach happenimi vehammenora eno chayyav mita]:
Sidder hammaaracha porkah vechozer hakkohen vesodrah mippene shessiddurah pasul:
Hattame uvaal mum veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim sheshshimmesh bammikdash enan chayyavin ella al avodot shehazzar chayyav alehen mita. veal shear haavodot beazhara:
Kohen tevul yom umechussar kippurim shennitma vahare hu mechussar begadim veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim veavad chayyav al kol echad veechad. veim haya zar eno loke ella achat mishshum zarut:
Zar sheshshimmesh beshabbat chayyav mishshum shabbat umishshum zarut. vechen baal mum sheshshimmesh betuma chayyav mishshum tuma umishshum baal mum:

Kol kohen sheavad avoda zara ben bemezid ben beshogeg af al pi shechazar bitshuva gemura hare ze lo yeshammesh bammikdash leolam shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 44 13)</small> "velo yiggeshu elay lechahen li". echad haoved otah besherut kegon shennaasa komer laavoda zara o hammishtachave lah o hammode bah vekibbelah alav beeloah hare ze pasul leolam. avar vehikriv en karbano reach nichoach af al pi shehaya shogeg beet sheshsheret o shehishtachava o shehoda. aval hashshochet laavoda zara beshogeg im avar vehikriv karbano reach nichoach venitkabbel shehare lo sheret velo naasa komer ella shachat bilvad vehu shogeg veaf al pi chen lechattechilla lo yaavod:

Mi sheavar veasa bayit chutz lammikdash lehakeriv bo karbano lashshem eno kevet avoda zara veaf al pi chen kol kohen sheshshimmesh bevayit kaze lo yeshammesh bammikdash leolam. vechen kelim shennishtammeshu bahen sham lo yishtammeshu bahen bammikdash leolam ella yigganzu. veyerae li sheim avad kohen sheshshimmesh sham bammikdash lo pasal:

Nimtzeu kol happesulin laavoda shemona asar veellu hen. haoved avoda zara. hazzar. baal mum. hearel. hattame. tevul yom. mechussar kippurim. haonen. hashshikkor. mechussar begadim. yater begadim. perum begadim. perua rosh. shello rachatz yadayim veraglayim. hayyoshev. mi sheyyesh ben yado uven hakkeli davar chotzetz. mi sheyyesh ben raglo uven haaretz davar chotzetz. mi sheavad bismolo. kol ellu pesulin laavoda veim avdu chillelu. chutz mipperua rosh ukerua begadim vehashshochet laavoda zara beshogeg. sheim avdu avodatan keshera:
Mishneh Torah, Things Forbidden on the A: Mitzvat ase lihyot kol hakkarbanot temimin umuvcharin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22-21)</small> "tamim yihye leratzon" zo mitzvat ase:

Vechol hammakdish behema sheyyesh bah mum legabbe hammizbeach over belo taase veloke al hekdesho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22-20)</small> "kl asher bo mum lo takrivu" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lemakdish baale mumin afillu hikdisho lidme [nesachim] loke shebbizyon kadashim hu:

Hammitkavven lomar shelamim veamar ola ola veamar shelamim lo amar kelum ad sheyyihyu piv velibbo shavim. lefichach hammitkavven lomar al baal mum ola vehikdisho shelamim o shelamim veamar ola af al pi shennitkavven leissur eno loke. mi sheddimma shemmuttar lehakedish baal mum lammizbeach vehikdish hare ze kadosh veeno loke:

Hashshochet baal mum leshem karban loke shehare neemar bevaale mumin <small>(Vayikra 22:22)</small> "lo takrivu elle laAdonai". umippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lashshochet. vechen hazzorek dam baale mumin al hammizbeach loke shehare neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 22-24)</small> "lo takrivu (elle) laAdonai" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lazzorek. vechen hammaktir emure baale mumin al hammizbeach loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:22)</small> "veishshe lo tittenu mehem al hammizbeach" ellu hachalavim. nimtzeta lamed sheim hikdish baal mum ushechato vezarak damo vehiktir emurav loke arba malkiyyot:

Echad baal mum kavua o baal mum over im hikrivo over bechol ellu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17-1)</small> "lo tizbach laAdonai elohecha shor vase asher yihye vo mum". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara levaal mum over. kegon shehaya bivhema garav lach o chazazit im hikrivah loke:
Velo karbenot yisrael bilvad ella af karbenot akkum im hikrivan vehen baale mumin loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:25)</small> "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem mikkol elle":

Hammattil mum bekadashim kegon shessimme eno o kata yado loke shehare neemar bekarban <small>(Vayikra 22-21)</small> "kol mum lo yihye bo". mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara shello yitten bo mum. veeno loke ella bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam shehare haya rauy lekarban ufesalo. aval bazzeman hazze af al pi sheavar belo taase eno loke:
Hetil mum bekadashim uva acher vehetil bah mum acher hashsheni eno loke:

Echad hammetil mum bakkadashim atzman o bitmuratan chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser shehammetil mum bitmuratan eno loke lefi sheenan reuyin lekarban kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. vechen hammetil mum batteshii shel taut asiri eno loke:

Hammakdish baalat mum lammizbeach af al pi shelloke hare zo nitkaddesha vetippade beerech hakkohen vetetze lechullin veyavi bedameha karban. vechen haddin bevehemat kadashim shennafal bah mum. umitzvat ase hi lifdot kadashim shennolad bahen mum veyetzu lechullin veyeachlu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12:15)</small> "rak bechol avvat nafshecha tizbach veachalta vasar". mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkatuv medabber bifsule hammukdashin sheyyippadu. uchevar bearnu baarachin shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27-11)</small> "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmennu karban laAdonai" shehu medabber bevaale mumin shennifdu:

Ma ben baalat mum kavua levaalat mum over. shebbaalat mum kavua im yalda vehi kodesh yippade havvalad veyetze lechullin af al pi shehu tamim kede shello yihye tafel chamur min haikkar. veim nitabbera kodem shettippade veyalda achar pidyon havvalad chullin. veim meta kodem shettippade nifdet achar shettamut. shehare lo chala kedushsha gemura al gufah ella al dameha mippene shehayta baalat mum kavua. aval hammakdish baalat mum over o temima veachar shehikdishah nolad lah mum kavua. im meta kodem shettippade tikkaver kishar hakkadashim hattemimim mippene shehi tzericha haamada vehaaracha kemo shebbearnu baarachin. veim nishchata kodem shettippade hare zo nifdet kol zeman shehi mefarkeset veachar kach teachel. veim yalda yikrav veladah. nitabbera kodem shettippade veyalda achar shennifdet havvalad asur veeno nifde. ella ketzad yaase. samuch lefidyon immo matpis ze havvalad leshem oto hazzevach. lefi sheeno yachol lehakerivo [mikkoach immo] mippene shebba mikkoach kedushsha dechuya:

Kol pesule hammukdashin kesheyyippadu muttar leshochotan beshuk shel tabbachim ulemachran sham velishkol besaram belitra kishar hachullin chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. mippene shemmechiratam bashshuk mosif bidmehen. shear hakkadashim sheddemehen chozrin lahekdesh shehare mevi bidmehem behema acheret mochrin otan bashshuk kechullin. aval habbechor vehammaaser sheen demehem lahekdesh ella neechalin bemuman kemo sheyyitbaer en shochatin otam beshuk shel tabbachim. veen mochrin otam sham. afillu hitpis bechor levedek habbayit eno nishkal belitra velo yimmacher bashshuk sheeno yachol lehatepis ella davar hakkanuy lo kinyan gamur:

Kol hammumin happoslin baadam uvabbehema chamishshim uchevar nimnu:
Veyesh mumin acherim meyuchadin babbehema veenan reuyin lihyot beadam. ushelosha veesrim hem veellu hen. im haya galgal enah agol keshel adam. enah achat gedola keshel egel vehashsheniyya ketanna keshel avvaz. aval im hayta ozen gedola veozen ketanna afillu ketanna ad kefol kasher. im yesh beloven enah yabbelet sheyyesh bah sear. im nikkav haor shebben shene chotameha bammakom hannire. piha dome leshel chazir parus af al pi sheeno mechuddad keshippud:
Chitteha hachitzonot shennikkevu o shennifgemu af al pi shennishar miktzatan o shennigmemu im neekru chitteha happenimiyyot shehare beet sheppotachat piha vetzovachat hen nirin chaserin:
Im nittelu karneha vezichrutan immahen velo nishar mehen kelum. aval nekeva sheyyesh lah karnayim keshera. im nifgam haor shechofe et gid habbehema. im nifgema haerva shel nekeva. im nifgam hazzanav min haetzem aval lo min happerek. im hayta rosh hazzanav mefutztzal lishnayim bishne atzamim. im haya ben chulya lechulya melo etzba basar. im haya hazzanav katzar. vead kamma. bigdi chulya achat mum shetayim kasher. uvetale orech shete chulyot mum. hayta shalosh kasher. zenav haggedi shehaya rach umeduldal dome leshel chazir. im nishbar etzem min hazzanav. aval im nishbar etzem mitztzalotav kasher mippene sheeno begaluy:
Baalat chamesh raglayim o en lah ella shalosh raglayim. im hayta achat meraglav veyadav parsatah agulla keshel chamor af al pi shehi seduka uferusa. im hayta yado o raglo keluta keshel chamor vezehu <small>(Vayikra 22-23)</small> "kalut" haamur battora. im nigmemu telafeha vezichrutan immahen af al pi shennishar mizzichrutan meat karov labbasar: 
Kol mum mishshelosha veshivim mum hammenuyin babbehema poslin otah min hakkarban. veim nafal echad mehem bitmima shehi kodesh tippade vetetze lechullin. chutz mizzaken vechole umezoham sheaf al pi sheeno kasher lekarban eno nifde. ella yihye kayyam veroe ad sheyyivvaled bo mum acher kavua mishshear hammumin veyippade. vechen behemat kadashim shennolad bah mum over enah kereva velo nifdet:
Arbaa mumin ovrim yesh baadam uvabbehema veellu hen. garav lach. chazazit sheenah mitzrit. mayim sheyyordin baayin veenan kevuin. sanvirin sheenan kevuin:
Yesh sham arbaa cholayim acherim im nimtza echad mehem bivhema en makrivin otah. lefi sheenah min hammuvchar vehakkatuv omer <small>(Devarim 12-11)</small> "mivchar nedarecha". veellu hen. mi shebbeloven eno yabbelet sheen bo sear. im nigmemu karnav af al pi shennishar mizzichrutan meat samuch labbasar. im nifgemu chittav happenimiyyot. im haya echad meellu bekadashim lo kerevin velo nifdin. ella yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum. veim hikrivan yerae li shehurtzu:
Vechen behemat kadashim shenneevda bah avera o shehemita et haadam beed echad o al pi habbealim lo kereva velo nifdet ad sheyyivvaled lah mum kavua:
Behema shennolad bah achat min hatterefiyyot haosrot otah baachila asura legabbe hammizbeach hare hu omer <small>(Malachi 1-8)</small> "hakerivehu na lefechatecha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha". veaf al pi sheenah reuya lekarban en podin otah sheen podin et hakkadashim lehaachilan lakkelavim. ella yiru ad sheyyamutu veyikkavru:
Nishchata venimtzet terefa hare zo tetze levet hasserefa. vechen im nimtza echad meevareha happenimiyyin chaser af al pi sheenah terefa kegon shennimtzet bechulya achat o shennittal hattechol hare zo asura lammizbeach vetissaref. lo mippene shehi baalat mum sheen chissaron shebbifnim mum ella mippene sheen makrivin chaser kelal shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28-19)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 28:31)</small> <small>(Bamidbar 29-8)</small> "temimim yihyu lachem". vechol hayyater kechaser lefichach im nimtza sham shalosh kulyot o shene techolim pesula: 
E zo hi sanvirin kevuim kol sheshshaha shemonim yom velo raa. uvodkin oto shalosh peamim beyom shiva veesrim meet shehirgishu bo uveyom arbaa vachamishshim uveyom shemonim. im raa monim lo shemonim meet sheppaska hariyya:
Uvamme yivvada shehammayim kevuin. kesheachla asavim lachim merosh adar ad chatzi nisan veachla achare chen asavim yeveshim elul vachatzi tishre velo nitrappea hare ellu mayim kevuim:
Vechamma tochal measavim ellu hallachim bazzeman hallach vehayeveshim bazzeman hayyavesh. kigrogeret o yoter kodem seudda rishona shel kol yamim bishlosha chodashim ellu. vetzarich shettochal otan bechol yom achar shetiyya. vetihye mutteret bassade beet achila. velo tihye levaddah ella hi uvehema acheret letzavvevt immah. im naasa lah kol ellu velo nitrappet hare ellu kevuin vadday. veim chaser echad mikkol ellu hare ze safek veenah kereva velo nifdet:
Ketzad. achla hallach kemishpato baadar kullo vachatzi nisan veachla acharav hayyavesh kemishpato bachatzi nisan veiyyar shennimtza sheachla bishlosha chodashim al hasseder. o sheachla kigrogeret achar achila o kodem shetiyya o shehayta keshura o shehayta levaddah o shehayta bagginna hassemucha lair velo nitrappet mikkol ellu safek kevuin o ovrim. lefichach im hetil bah mum acher eno loke. achalah kemishpatah bizmanne haachila velo nitrappea hare hi baalat mum kavua:
Yesh baddavar safek im lemafrea hi baalat mum kavua meet shebbau lah hammumim o meet shennityaashu merfuatah. lefichach happode otah kodem shennityaashu merfuatah venehene beoto happidyon achar shennityaashu merfuatah hare ze safek moel veeno mevi karban meila kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

En hammumin poslin baof vechen echad hazzachar veechad hannekeva baof shello neemar <small>(Vayikra 22-19)</small> "tamim zachar" ella bivhema bilvad. bamme devarim amurim bemumin ketannim. aval of sheyyavash gappo o nismet eno o niktea raglo asur legabbe hammizbeach sheen makrivin chaser kelal. vechen im nolad bo achat min hatterefot sheosrin otah baachila hare ze nifsal lekarban:
Torim ketannim pesulin uvene yona gedolim pesulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1:14)</small> "min hattorim o min bene hayyona". techillat hatztzihuv baze uvaze pasul. vead matay yihyu bene yona kesherim kol zeman sheoker kanaf umitmalle mekom ikkaro dam. vehattorim kesherim mishsheyyizhavu:
Hattumtum vehaanderoginus af al pi sheen lecha mum gadol mehen hare hen pesulin lammizbeach midderech acheret lefi shehen safek zachar safek nekeva hare hen kemin acher. uvakkarbanot neemar <small>(Vayikra 1-3)</small> <small>(Vayikra 1-10)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4-23)</small> "zachar tamim" u<small>(Vayikra 4-32)</small> "nekeva temima" ad sheyyihye zachar vadday o nekeva vaddait. lefichach af haof shehu tumtum o anderoginus pasul lammizbeach: 
Vechen hakkilayim veyotze dofen umechussar zeman pesulin af al pi sheen bahem mum shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "shor o chesev o ez" ad sheyyihye kol min umin bifne atzmo lo sheyyihye meorav mikkeves veez. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "ki yivvaled" perat leyotze dofen. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "vehaya shivat yamim" perat limchussar zeman. <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "tachat immo" perat leyatom shennolad achar shennishchata immo:
Hannidme af al pi sheeno kilayim hare hu pasul lammizbeach. ketzad. rachel sheyyalda kemin ez veez sheyyalda kemin keves. af al pi sheyyesh bo miktzat simanin hoil vehu dome lemin acher pasul kevaal mum kavua sheen lecha mum kavua gadol min hashshinnuy:
Vechen harovea vehannirba vehammuktze laavoda zara vehanneevad af al pi shehen muttarin baachila hare hen pesulin legabbe hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:25)</small> "ki mashchatam bahem" kol sheyyesh bo hashechata pasul. uvaavera hu omer <small>(Bereshit 6:12)</small> "ki hishchit kol basar". uvaavoda zara ketiv <small>(Shemot 32-7)</small> <small>(Devarim 9:12)</small> "ki shichet ammecha". vechen behema veof shehargu et haadam hare hen kerovea o nirba ufesulin lammizbeach: 
Veyerae li sheaf al pi sheen kol happesulin haellu reuyin lammizbeach lekarban im avar vehikrivan eno loke min hattora lefi shello nitparsha azharatan. <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "aval etnan zona umechir" kelev asurin legabbe hammizbeach vehammakriv echad mehen o shenehen keechad loke achat shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev". umippene ma loke achat al shenehen mippene shenneemru belav echad: 
Mitzvat ase lehakeriv kol hakkarbanot miyyom hashshemini vahala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22:27)</small> "vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze". vechol shivat hayyamim nikra mechussar zeman. veaf al pi shemmechussar zeman pasul im avar vehikrivo eno loke mippene shehu lav habba mikkelal ase velo nirtza hakkarban:
Torim shello higgia zemannan shehen kimchussar zeman bivhema uvene yona sheavar zemannan hakkol kevaal mum vehammakrivan eno loke af al pi shehakkarban pasul velo nirtza:
Hammakdish tumtum veanderoginus uterefa vechilayim veyotze dofen lammizbeach hare ze kemakdish etzim vaavanim. lefi sheen kedushsha chala al gufan vahare hen chullin lechol davar. veyimmachru veyavi bidmehem kol karban sheyyirtze. veenan kevaal mum shebbaal mum yesh bemino karban. aval hammakdish rovea venirba umuktze veneevad veetnan umechir hare ze kemakdish baal mum over. veyiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum kavua veyippadu alav. vechen hammakdish mechussar zeman hare ze kemakdish baal mum over veeno loke kemo shebbearnu:
Nimtzeu kol haissurin lammizbeach hare hen 14 veellu hen. baal mum. vesheeno min hammuvchar. umechussar evar mibbifnim. uterefa. vechilayim. veyotze dofen. verovea. venirba. veshehemit haadam. hanneevad. hammuktze. haetnan. hammechir. mechussar zeman:
Kol haasurin legabbe hammizbeach osrin bechol shehen afillu nitarev echad beribbo nifsad hakkol venifsal lammizbeach. vechullan valdotehen muttarin lammizbeach chutz mivvelad nirbaat veneevedet umuktzet veshehemita et haadam shevveladan asurin lammizbeach kemotan:
Bamme devarim amurim keshenneevda bah avera o shehemita keshehayta meebberet shehare havvalad matzuy immah beet shennifsela vehaya keevar meevareha. aval im nitabbera achar shenneevda bah avera o achar shehemita hare veladah kasher lammizbeach afillu nirbea keshehi mukdeshet veachar kach nitabbera. veen tzarich lomar im nirbea vehi chullin veachar kach hikdishah venitabbera shevveladah muttar. vechen efroach betzat terefa muttar lammizbeach:
Hammishtachave lakkama chitteha muttarin limnachot shehare nishtannu venidmu livladot shel issur mizbeach shehen muttarin. vechen behema sheppittemah becharshine avoda zara mutteret lammizbeach shehare nishtannu:
Lokchin kol hakkarbanot min haakkum veen choshshin lahem lo mishshum rovea venirba velo mishshum muktze veneevad. ad sheyyivvada bevadday shezze nifsal. hare hu omer <small>(Shmuel 1 15-15)</small> "meamaleki hevium asher chamal haam al metav hatztzon vehabbakar lemaan zevoach laAdonai elohecha":

Echad habbehema veechad haof shennirbea o shehemit et haadam o huktza o neevad hakkol pasul legabbe hammizbeach:
Harovea vehannirba veshehemit et haadam im hayu sham shene edim hare habbehema o haof niskalin uvesaran asur bahanaa. veen tzarich lomar beellu shehen asurin legavoah. uvamme amru shehen asurin lammizbeach keshehayu muttarin lehedyot. kegon shehaya sham ed echad bilvad vehabbealim shotkin o al pi habbealim af al pi sheen ed kelal. haya sham ed echad vehabbealim machchishin oto hare ellu muttarin af lammizbeach:
Behema shessachaku bah vehiggichuha ad shehemita et haadam hare zo keshera lammizbeach mippene shehi kaanusa. en habbehema nifselet mishshum rovea o nirba ad sheyyihye haadam shervaah ben tesha shanim veyom echad. ben yisrael ben akkum [ben] eved hoil urevaah adam nifsela. veim haadam hu shennirba min habbehema enah nifselet ad shettihye haishsha hannirbaat bat shalosh shanim veyom echad o yehe haish hannirba ben tesha shanim veyom echad:
Meematay tippasel habbehema o haof mishshum muktze mishsheyyaasu bahen hakkemarim maase. kegon sheyyigzezu otah o yaavdu bah leshem avoda zara. aval bidvarim eno naase muktze sheen hekdesh laavoda zara:
Harovea vehannirba ben shehayta habbehema shello ben shehayta shel chavero ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben lifne hekdeshah ben leachar hekdeshah hare zo asura lammizbeach. aval hammuktze im hi shello vehuktza kodem sheyyakdish nifsal. hiktza shel chavero o shehiktza shello achar shehikdisho hare ze muttar. sheen adam maktze davar sheeno shello:
Hanneevad ben sheavad shello ben shel chavero ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben lifne hekdesh ben leachar hekdesh hare ze asur. veyire ad sheyyippol bo mum kavua veyippade bo kemo shebbearnu. vehanneevad hu vechol ma shealav asurin lammizbeach. shekkol tzippuy neevad asurin bahanaa. aval hammuktze hu asur uma shealav muttar lammizbeach:
Hammishtachave lehar af al pi shehu muttar bahanaa hare avanav asurin lammizbeach. vechen hammishtachave lemayan hannovea beartzo hare memav pesulin lenassech. ashera shebbatla en meviin mimmenna gezarim lammaaracha. vechen hammishtachave livhema keshem shennifsela lammizbeach kach tzemer shellah pasul levigde kehunna. vekarneha pesulin lachatzotzrot veshokeha lachalilin uvene meeha lenimin hakkol pasul:
Kol sheyyesh bo shem laavoda zara lo yease limlechet hakkodesh af al pi shehu muttar bahanaa. e zehu <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "etnan" haomer lezona he lich davar ze bischarech. echad zona kutit o shifcha o yisreelit shehi erva alav o mechayyave lavin. aval happenuya afillu haya kohen etnanah muttar. vechen ishto nidda etnanah muttar af al pi shehi erva:
Nasa achat mechayyave lavin kol sheyyitten lah mechamat beila hare ze etnan veasur. vehazzachur etnano asur. natna haishsha etnan labboel hare ze muttar mishshum etnan:
Haomer lachavero he lecha davar ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi haivri hare ze etnan. vehu sheen lo ishsha uvanim. aval im yesh lo ishsha uvanim hare ze muttar beshifcha kenaanit kemo sheyyitbaer. vehu haddin beomer lezona he lich davar ze vehibbaali lifloni hayyisreeli hare ze etnan:
Pasak im hazzona litten lah tale echad venatan lah harebe afillu natan elef kullan etnan vaasurin lammizbeach. natan lah etnanah velo ba aleha ella amar lah yehi etzlech ad sheavo alayich kesheyyavo aleha yeaser. kadma vehikrivattu kodem sheyyavo aleha kasher [veim hayta chayyevet karban yatza yede chovatah]. vehu sheyyomar lah beet shennatan ematay shetteratzi li keni oto meachshav. aval im lo amar lah ken enah yechola lehakeriv davar sheenah shellah:
Kadma vehikdishattu kodem sheyyavo aleha veachar kach ba aleha hare ze safek im hu etnan hoil uva aleha kodem shettakrivennu. o eno etnan shehare hikdishattu kodem bia. lefichach lo yikkarev veim karav nirtza:
Ba aleha velo natan lah uleachar zeman natan lah afillu achar kamma shanim hare ze etnan. bamme devarim amurim bechutit sheamar lah hibbaali li betale ze sheenah tzericha meshicha. o beyisreelit shehaya hattale bachatzerah veamar lah im lo etten lach maot beyom peloni hare hu shellach. aval im amar lah hibbaali li betale setam uva aleha uleachar zeman shalach lah tale hare ze muttar mishshum etnan:
En asur mishshum etnan umechir ella gufan. lefichach eno chal ella al davar harauy likkarev al gabbe hammizbeach. kegon behema tehora vetorin uvene yona veyayin veshemen vesolet. natan lah maot velakcha bahen karban hare ze kasher:
Natan lah chittim vaasaatan solet. zetim vaasaatan shemen. anavim vaasaatan yayin. hare ellu kesherim shekkevar nishtannu. natan lah behemat kadashim beetnanah lo neesra lammizbeach. vaafillu mana otah al pischo veal chagigato beetnanah lo nifselu hammukdashin shekkevar zacha bahen gavoah mishshaa shehikdishan. vechen im natan lah davar sheeno shello lo pesalo sheen adam oser davar sheeno shello ella im ken nityaashu habbealim. aval im natan lah ofot af al pi shehen mukdashin etnan chal alehem vaasurim umiddivre kabbala hu davar ze:
E ze hu <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "mechir kelev". ze haomer lachavero he lecha tale ze tachat kelev ze. vechen im hechlif kelev bechamma behemot o ofot vechayyotze bahen kullan asurot lammizbeach:
Shene shuttafin shechalku. ze lakach asara telaim veze lakach tisha vechelev echad. sheim hakkelev muttarin. aval haasara shekkenegdo im yesh echad mehem damav kidme hakkelev o yater al deme hakkelev motzio min haasara keneged hakkelev veyihye mechiro usheeran muttarim. veim kol echad veechad mehen damav pechutin middeme hakkelev hare haasara kullan asurim:
Nishtanna hammechir kegon shehechlif kelev bechittim venaasu solet hare ze muttar. etnan kelev umechir zona muttarin. <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "etnan zona umechir kelev" muttarin levedek habbayit shehare hen mishtannin. aval gufan shel etnan lo yease rikkuin labbayit shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23-19)</small> "lechol neder" lehavi et harikkuim:

Seor udevash asurin legabbe hammizbeach veissuran bechol shehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:11)</small> "ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru" vegomer. veeno chayyav ella im hiktiran im hakkarban o leshem karban. veechad hammaktir atzman o hammaktir taarovot shellahen loke al kol echad mehen bifne atzmo. veim hiktir shenehen keechad eno loke ella achat lefi sheshshenehem neemru belav echad:
Nafal mehem kol shehu bakketoret nifsela. veim hiktir mimmenna bahechol loke. veen haketara pechuta mikkezayit:
Heela seor o devash bifne atzman lammizbeach leshem etzim patur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:12)</small> "veel hammizbeach lo yaalu lereach nichoach". lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshem etzim. afillu hiktir davar sheeno rauy lehaketara bidvash o bisor hoil vehu min hakkarban loke:
Ketzad. hammaale mibbesar chattat veasham o mibbesar kadashim kallim o mishsheyare hammenachot o mimmotar haomer o mechattat haof o millechem happanim ushete hallechem o millog shemen shel metzora hammaale kezayit meachat meellu bechametz o bidvash ben lammizbeach ben lakkevesh loke. af al pi sheen kol ellu reuyin lehaketara hoil vehen keruyin karban chayyav alehen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:12)</small> "karban reshit takrivu otam laAdonai" vegomer:
Vechen asur lehaketir al hammizbeach davar mikkol devarim ellu sheenan reuyin lehaketara. kegon besar chattaot vaashamot usheyare menachot vechayyotze bahen. mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol davar shemmiktzato laishshim hare sheerito beval taktiru:
Hammaktir evre behema temea al gabbe hammizbeach loke. veaf al pi sheissur hakeravatah mikkelal ase shehare neemar min hattehora echol umin hattehora hakerev ha temea lo tochal velo takriv. keshem shelloke al achilat hattemea habba mikkelal ase kemo shebbearnu bimkomo kach loke al hakeravatah. aval hammakriv evre chayya tehora over baase veeno loke. uminnayin shehu baase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1:2)</small> "min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon takrivu et karbanchem" ha min hachayya lo takrivu velav habba mikkelal ase ase:
Haggonev o haggozel vehikriv hakkarban pasul vehakkadosh baruch hu sono shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 61-8)</small> "sone gazel beola" veen tzarich lomar sheeno mitkabbel. veim nityaashu habbealim hakkarban kasher. vaafillu haya chattat shehakkohanim ochlin et besarah. umippene takkanat mizbeach amru shehachattat haggezula im noda larabbim enah mechapperet af al pi shennityaashu habbealim kede shello yomru mizbeach ochel gezelot vechen haola:
Haggonev olat chavero vehikrivah setam nitkapperu bah habbealim harishonim:
En meviin menachot unesachim lo min hattevel velo min hechadash kodem laomer velo min hamedumma veen tzarich lomar mearla vechile hakkarem mippene shehi mitzva habbaa baavera shehakkadosh baruch hu sonah. veim hevi lo nitkaddeshu lihyotan reuyin lekarban aval nitkaddeshu lehippasel veyihyu kekadashim shennifselu:
Kol hammenachot en meviin otan min hechadash kodem shete hallechem lechattechilla shehare neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 2-14)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23-17)</small> "bikkurim laAdonai". veim hevi kasher. umeviim nesachim min hammuktze beyom tov: 
Mitzvat ase limloach kol hakkarbanot kodem sheyyaalu lammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:13)</small> "al kol karbancha takriv melach". veen lecha davar shekkarev lammizbeach belo melach chutz miyyen hannesachim vehaddam vehaetzim. vedavar ze kabbala veen lo mikra lismoch alav. umitzva limloach habbasar yafe yafe kemoleach basar letzali shemmehappech et haevar umoleach. veim malach kol shehu afillu begargir melach echad kasher:
Hikriv belo melach kelal loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 2:13)</small> "velo tashbit melach berit elohecha". veaf al pi shelloke hakkarban kasher vehurtza. chutz min hammincha shehammelach meakkev bakkemitza shenneemar "velo tashbit melach berit elohecha meal minchatecha": 
Hammelach shemmolchin bo kol hakkarbanot mishshel tzibbur kemo haetzim. veen hayyachid mevi melach o etzim lekarbano mibbeto. uvishlosha mekomot hayu notnin hammelach. belishkat hammelach. veal gabbe hakkevesh. uverosho shel mizbeach. belishkat hammelach hayu molchin orot hakkadashim. veal gabbe hakkevesh molchin haevarim. uverosho shel mizbeach molchin hakkometz vehallevona umenachot hannisrafot veolat haof:

Keshem shemmitzva lihyot kol karban tamim venivchar kach hannesachin yihyu temimim venivcharim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28:31)</small> "temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem" sheyyihyu hannesachim temimim shello yavi nesachim lo miyyayin meeshshan velo solet shehitlia velo yivlol beshemen sherecho o tamo ra:
Vechen atze hammaaracha lo yihyu ella nivcharim velo yihye bahem tolaat. vechol etz shehitlia keshehu lach pasul lammizbeach. hitlia yavesh gorer et hammakom shehitlia. vaatze setira pesulin leolam lo yaviu ella chadashim:
Hammakdish yayin pasul o solet o shemen pasul o etzim pesulim lammizbeach hare haddavar safek im domim levaal mum kivhema veloke o enan kevaal mum lefichach eno loke umakkin oto makkat mardut:
Hassolet vehayyayin vehashshemen vehallevona vehaofot vehaetzim uchele sharet shennifselu o shennitmeu en podin otan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27-11)</small> "veheemid" <small>(Vayikra 27-12)</small> "veheerich". kol sheyyeshno behaamada neerach veellu enan bichlal haamada. lefichach en nifdin leolam:
Bamme devarim amurim beshennifselu o shennitmeu achar shennitkaddeshu bichli sharet. aval kodem sheyyitkaddeshu bichli im nitmeu o nifselu podin otan. aval tehorin af al pi sheadayin lo kadshu bichli en podin otan chutz mimminchat chote shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 5-10)</small> "mechattato" <small>(Vayikra 5-13)</small> "al chattato" lomar shemmevi chattato middeme chattato. lefichach kodem shettitkaddesh bichli sharet hare hi kikdushshat damim ufodin otah af al pi shehi tehora. vechol hannesachim shennitmeu ose lahem maaracha bifne atzman vesorfan bammizbeach:
Me hechag shennitmeu vehishshikan vetiharan [kemo sheyyitbaer betohorot]. im tiharan veachar kach hikdishan hare ellu mitnassechin. veim hikdishan veachar kach nitmeu hoil venidchu yiddachu:
Zetim vaanavim shennitmeu dorchan pachot mikkabbetza. vehammashkin hayyotzin mehen kesherim linsachim. shehammashke mufkad hu baochel ucheillu eno miggufo:
Maala yetera asu chachamim bekadashim shezzeraim shennitmeu afillu zeraan hayyotze mehen pesulin linsachim sheen zeria moelet bekadashim. vechen haetzim vehallevona af al pi sheenan ochalin hare hen mittammein keochel leinyan hakkarbanot veyippaslu haetzim vehallevona betuma zo lammizbeach veen makrivin otan:
Veellu hen hayyenot happesulin legabbe hammizbeach. hammatok vehameeshshan vehamevushshal beesh o bashshemesh o shennishtanna tamo bevishshul. aval yayin shemmechammemin oto bashshemesh velo natna bo taam bishshul. vechen yen tzimmukin veyayin miggitto shello shaha arbaim yom. veyen haddaliyyot veyen kerem hannatua bevet hashshelachin o bevet hazzevalim. o yen gefanim shennizra zera benehen. o yen kerem shello neevad. kol ellu hayyenot lo yavi lechattechilla veim hevi kasher:
Yayin shennitgalla pasul legabbe hammizbeach. hidla gefen al gabbe teena yenah pasul linsachim mippene shennishtanna recho. hare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 23-37)</small> "zevach unesachim" ma zevach shello nishtanna af nesachim shello nishtannu:
Solet shehitlia rubbah o hitliu rov hachittim shennaaset mehen pesula. hitlia rov chitta achat hare ze safek. vechol solet shennishar bah kemach pesula:
Ketzad bodkim. machnis haggizbar yado letoch hassolet im ala bah avak pesula ad sheyyachazor vinappe otah. aval solet chittim shennizreu bevet hashshelachin o bevet hazzevalim o bevet hailan o beeretz shello narah velo avadah lo yavi lechattechilla veim hevi keshera:
Chittim shellekatan miggelale habbakar uzeraam hare ellu safek im avra meusan bazzeria o adayin hen meusin. lefichach lo yavi mehen menachot veim hevi kasher:
Veellu hen hashshemanim happesulin. shemen shel gargerim shennishru bemayim o shel zetim kevushin o shelukim o shemen shel shemarim o shemen sherecho ra kol ellu pesulin. aval shemen zayit shennetao bevet hazzevalim o bevet hashshelachin o shennizra zera benehen. o shemen shehotzio mizzetim shello bashlu ella adayin hem paggin kol ellu lo yavi. veim hevi kasher:
Kol hammenachot vehannesachim kesherim mehaaretz umichutza laaretz min hechadash umin hayyashan uvilvad sheyyaviu min hammuvchar. chutz min haomer ushete hallechem sheenan bain ella min hechadash umeeretz yisrael:

Lo kol davar sheeno pasul mevi oto lechattechilla. ketzad. haya chayyav ola lo yavi se kachush vechaur veyomar hare en bo mum. veal ze neemar <small>(Malachi 1-14)</small> "vearur nochel" vegomer. ella kol sheyyavi lekarban yavi min hammuvchar:
Vechach hayu osin bizman hammikdash. meviin elim mimmoav. umeviin kevasim sheggabbehen rechavim mechevron. umeviin agalim min hashsharon. vegozalot mehar hammelech. umeviin yayin mikkarchiyyin vehallotiyyin. vesolet mimmichmash veyochana. umeviin shemen mittekoa:
Kol haetzim hachadashim kesherim lammaaracha. velo hayu meviin mishshel zayit velo mishshel gefen mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael. uveellu hayu regilin bemurbiyyot shel teena shel chadashim sheenan bayyishshuv. uveshel egoz uveshel etz shemen. vehaggezarin sheasa moshe amma arkan veamma rachban veavyan kemachak gadish shel sea uchemotan osin ledorot:
Vechetzad hayu osin bizriat chitte hammenachot vehannesachim. nar chatzi hassade beshana rishona vezara chetzyah. uveshana sheniyya nar hachetzi shezzara barishona vezara hachetzi haacher kodem lappesach shivim yom. veim lo hayta hassade avudda choresh veshone veachar kach zorea. uvorer hachittim yafe yafe veachar kach shaf et hachittim uvoet bahen harebe ad sheyyitkallefu:
Kol hachittim shel menachot teunot shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita. shaf achat uvoet shetayim. shaf shetayim uvoet shalosh. nimtzeu shalosh shifot vachamesh beitot. vechozer chalila ad sheyyigmor shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita kede sheyyitkallefu harebe. vechoshev hahovaa vehaholacha beshifa achat lehachemir veachar kach tochen umerakked yafe yafe:
Hayyayin. mevi anavim min haragliyyot min hakkeramim haavuddim paamayim beshana. vedorech vechonsin oto bechaviyyot ketannot. veen mannichin otan achat achat velo shetayim shetayim ella shalosh shalosh. veeno memalle et hechavit ad piha kede sheyyihye recho nodef. veeno mevi lo mippi hechavit mippene hakkemachin haole al pene hayyayin. velo mishshuleha mippene hashshemarim. ella mishshelishah umeemtzaah shel emtzait:
Haya haggizbar yoshev vehayyayin yotze min hannekev shebbetzad hechavit kevan sheyyire shinnuy hashshemarim matchil latzet posek veeno lokeach. umeematay mevi. meachar arbaim yom lidrichato ad shete shanim o yeter meat. veim hevi yayin yashan mikkamma shanim hare ze kasher vehu shello yippased taamo:
Tisha minin beshemen mippene shinnuy maasav. ketzad. zayit sheggirgero berosh hazzayit uverro achat achat uchetasho unetano lesal hashshemen sheyyetze mimmennu hu harishon. chazar achar kach uteano bekora hashshemen sheyyetze mimmennu hu hashsheni. veim chazar achar shetteano utechano uteano sheniyya hashshemen sheyyetze mimmennu hu hashshelishi. zetim shemmesakan kullan beirbuveya veheelan laggag vechazar uverer garger garger uchetashan unetanan lesal hashshemen sheyyetze mimmennu hu harvii. veim teano bekora achar kach hashshemen sheyyetze hu hachamishi. vechazar vetachan vetaan paam sheniyya hashshemen sheyyetze hu hashshishshi. zetim shemmesakan uteanan betoch habbayit ad sheyyilku veheelan uniggevan veachar kach katash venatan lesal hashshemen sheyyetze hu hashshevii. chazar vetaan bakkora hashshemen sheyyetze hu hashshemini. chazar vetachan vetaan paam sheniyya hashshemen sheyyetze hu hatteshii:
Af al pi shekkullan kesherin limnachot. harishon en lemala mimmennu. veacharav hashsheni veharvii ushenehen shavin. veacharehem hashshelishi vehachamishi vehashshevii ushelashtan shavin. veacharehem hashshishshi vehashshemini ushenehem shavin. vehatteshii en lematta mimmennu:
En kasher lammenora ella rishon urevii ushevii bilvad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 27-20)</small> <small>(Vayikra 27-20)</small> "katit lammaor", en kasher lammenora ella hayyotze min hakkatush bilvad. aval lammenachot kullan kesherin: 
Umeachar shekkullan kesherin lammenachot lamma nimnu. kede leda yafe sheen lemala mimmennu vehashshave vehappachot sheharotze lizkot atzmo yachof yitzro hara veyarchiv yado veyavi karbano min hayyafe hammeshubbach beyoter shebbeoto hammin sheyyavi mimmennu. hare neemar battora <small>(Bereshit 4-4)</small> "vehevel hevi gam hu mibbechorot tzono umechelvehen vayyisha Adonai el hevel veel minchato". vehu haddin bechol davar shehu leshem hael hattov sheyyihye min hannae vehattov. im bana bet tefilla yihye nae mibbet yeshivato. heechil raev yaachil min hattov vehammatok shebbeshulchano. kissa arom yechasse min hayyafe shebbichsuto. hikdish davar yakdish min hayyafe shebbinchasav vechen hu omer <small>(Vayikra 3-16)</small> "kol chelev laAdonai" vegomer:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1: Kol hakkarbanot shel mine nefesh chayya bain mechamishsha minin bilvad. min habbakar umin hakkevasim umin haizzim umin hattorim umin bene hayyona:
Vechol hakkarbanot ben shel tzibbur ben shel yachid arbaa minin. ola. vechattat. veasham. ushelamim:
Veod yesh sham shelosha mine karban yachid vehem happesach. vehabbechor. vehammaaser:

Kol karbanot hatztzibbur hen ola o chattat. veen bekarbenot hatztzibbur shelamim chutz mishshene kevasim habbaim im lechem hattenufa baatzeret. vehem hannikraim zivche shalme tzibbur. veen hatztzibbur makrivin asham leolam velo of:

Karbenot hatztzibbur hem shene temidin shel kol yom. umusefe shabbatot verashe chodashim vehammoadot useir chattat shel yom hakkippurim. vechen im shaggu bet din vehoru baavoda zara mevi kol shevet veshevet par vesair. happar ola vehassair chattat. veellu hasseirim hem hannikraim seire avoda zara. veim shaggu vehoru bishar hammitzvot meviin par lechattat vehu hannikra par helem davar shel tzibbur:

Karbenot hayyachid hem habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach. vehachagiga vehi shelamim. vehariyya vehi olot. vekarban hagger vehu ola min habbehema. o shene bene yona o shete torim ushenehen ola. o shete behemot achat ola veachat shelamim. vehannoder o hammitnaddev ola o shelamim. ushelamim habbain im hallechem hem hannikraim toda. vechen karbenot hannazir vehen ola vechattat ushelamim. vekarbenot metzora vehen chattat veasham veola. vekarbenot zavim veyoldot vehen chattat veola. vekarban hashshogeg bemitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah karet vehu chattat. veim nistappek lo im asa o lo asa oto hachote mevi asham vehu hannikra asham taluy. veyesh averot shemmevi alehen asham vehu hannikra asham vadday. vechen el haola ufar hachattat shemmakriv kohen gadol mishshello beyom hakkippurim hare hen karban yachid. ufar ze hu hannikra par yom hakkippurim. vechol ellu hakkarbanot meforashin hen battora vechol echad mehen yitbaaru dinav bimkomo:

Kol karbenot hayyachid chayyav beacharayutan uveacharayut niskehen chutz min hannedava. vechol karbenot hatztzibbur enan chayyavin beacharayutan velo beacharayut niskehen. veim karav hazzevach chayyavin beacharayut niskehem. vekarban yachid shekkavua lo zeman hare hu kekarban tzibbur veeno chayyav beacharayuto:
Kol olat behema enah baa ella min hazzecharim bilvad. vehi baa min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar ben gedolim ben ketannim. umin hattorim uvene yona veechad bahen hazzachar vehannekeva:
Hachattat baa mechameshet hamminim haellu min hazzecharim umin hannekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim:
Haasham eno ba ella mizzichre kevasim bilvad. yesh asham ba miggedole min ze veyesh asham ba min hakketannim:

Hashshelamim baim min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar mizzecharim uminnekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim. veen haof ba shelamim. hakketannim hem mibben shemonat yamim ad shana temima miyyom leyom. im nitabbera shana nitabbera lo. vehaggedolim babbakar ad shalosh shanim shelemot miyyom leyom. uvatztzon ad shete shanim shelemot miyyom leyom. yoter al ze hare hu zaken veen makrivin oto:

Af al pi shekkol hakkarbanot kesherin miyyom hashshemini vahala en makrivin lechattechilla ella miyyom sheloshim vahala. chutz min habbechor umin happesach umin hammaaser sheim ratza lehakerivan bashshemini lechattechilla makriv:

Shaot monin lekadashim. veim hosifu shaa achat o pachatu shaa pesulin. ketzad. karban shemmitzvato lihyot ben shana im hosif al hashshana shaa achat nifsal. afillu haya ben shana bishat shechita vehosif al hashshana bishat zerika nifsal ad sheyyihye ben shana ad sheat zerika. vechen bechol hazzevachim:

Kol makom shenneemar battora keves o kavsa o kevasim hare ellu bene shana. vechol makom shenneemar ayil o elim hem hazzecharim bene shenatayim. umeematay yikkare ayil mishsheyyikkanes beshana sheniyya echad usheloshim yom. aval beyom sheloshim eno kasher lo lecheves velo laayil vehu hannikra pilgas. vechol makom shenneemar bo egel hare ze ben shana. par ben shetayim. seir izzim [ben shana. sair] ben shetayim. kol shana sheniyya hu nikra sair:

Kol karbenot hatztzibbur zecharim. vechen chattaot shel tzibbur min haez o min habbakar. veen bahen min hakkevasim. vechol olot hatztzibbur min hakkevasim umin habbakar. veen lahen ola min haez. kol chattat yachid nekeva veteachel lakkohanim veenah baa min habbakar. chutz mishshalosh chattaot. chattat nasi shehi ez veneechelet. vechattat kohen mashiach shehu par venisrefet vehu par habba al kol hammitzvot. vehashshelishi par shemmevi kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim vehu chattat venisraf:

Kol chattaot shel tzibbur neechalot chutz missair shel yom hakkippurim shechavero mishtalleach. vechen seire avoda zara ufar helem nisrafin. ufar habba al kol hammitzvot ufar helem nikraim parim hannisrafin. useire avoda zara nikraim seirim hannisrafin. ha lamadta shechamesh chattaot hem hannisrafot. shetayim layyachid veshalosh latztzibbur:

Kol hakkarbanot haellu nikraim zevachim. vechol haolot vehachattaot vehaashamot ushene kavse shelamim shel atzeret nikraim kadshe kadashim. aval shelamim shel yachid vehabbechor vehammaaser vehappesach nikraim kadashim kallim:

Haevarim shessorfin otan al gabbe hammizbeach min hachattaot hanneechalot umin haashamot umin hashshelamim hen hannikrain emurin. veellu hen haemurin shel shor o shel ez. hachelev asher al hakkerev uvichlalo chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva ushete hakkelayot vechelev shealehen im hachelev asher al hakkesalim veyoteret hakkaved venotel min hakkaved meat im hayyoteret. veim haya hakkarban mimmin hakkevasim mosif al ellu haalya temima im hachulyot min hashshidra ad mekom hakkelayot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 9)</small> "leemmat heatze yesirenna". vechol haemurin nisrafin al mizbeach hachitzon:
Hayta habbehema meubberet af al pi shekkalu chodashav shel ubbar vaafillu nimtza chay eno maale chelbo im chelev immo ella chelev immo bilvad. vahare haubbar keechad meevareha:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2:
Hayyayin vehassolet shemmeviin im hakkarban hem hannikrain nesachim. vehassolet levaddah nikret minchat nesachim. uminchat nesachim enah teuna lo tenufa velo haggasha velo levona. aval teuna melach. vechullah nisrefet al mizbeach hachitzon. veyitnassech hayyayin al hammizbeach. veen notnin oto al haesh ella magbiah yado veyotzek al hayesod vehu yored lashshitin:
En taun nesachin ella olat behema ushelamim bilvad ben hayu karban tzibbur o karban yachid o keves yoledet veelo shel kohen gadol hoil vehen olot teunim nesachim. aval haof vehaashamot vehachattaot en meviin immahem nesachim. chutz mechattat metzora vaashamo shennitparshu niskehem battora:
Uminnayin sheen meviin nesachim im hachattat vehaasham shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 3)</small> "lefalle neder o nedava" davar habba beneder unedava yatzu chattat veasham uvechor umaaser ufesach hoil veenan bain beneder unedava en teunin nesachim. uminnayin lehavi shalme chagiga veolat reiyya linsachim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 3)</small> "o bemoadechem":
Kamma hu shiur nesachim. niske keves o kavsa issaron solet balul birviit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech reviit hahin. vechen niske haez ben katan ben gadol ben zachar ben nekeva o niske rachel af al pi shehi gedola. aval niske ayil hen shene esronim solet balul bishlishit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech shelishit hahin. veniske happar o haegel ben zecharim ben nekevot shelosha esronim solet balul bachatzi hahin shemen veyayin lannesech chatzi hahin:
Ellu hen hannesachim ben laola ben lashshelamim kashshiur hazze lechol echad veechad shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 12)</small> "kammispar asher taasu kacha taasu laechad kemisparam". en mosifin al hashshiurin haellu veen gorin mehen. veim gara o hosif kol shehu pasul. chutz mikkeves haola shemmakrivin beyom hanafat haomer shehannesachim shello shene esronim balul bishlishit hahin shemen. af al pi shennichpela salto lo nichpelu yeno [veshamno] ella yayin lannesech reviit hahin:
Hametzora mevi im shelosha kevasim shello shehen chattat veasham veola shelosha esronim. umippi hashshemua lamdu shehen bain bichlal hazzevachim shello issaron im kol keves balul birviit hahin shemen. ureviit yayin im kol issaron mishshelashtan kishar niske hakkevasim. vehammakriv et happilgas mevi immo niske ayil velo ole lo zivcho:
Hahin hu shenem asar log. uchevar hodanu shiur hallog im middot acherot behilchot eruvin. vehaissaron hu haomer shehu shiur challa uchevar bearnu shiuro beinyan challa:
Keshemmoddin hannesachim o hammenachot ben minchat yachid ben minchat tzibbur en moddin oto bemidda shel shelosha esronim lappar o shel shenayim laayil ella moded hakkol beissaron echad shehaya bammikdash. vechen hashshemen shel nesachim moddin oto bemiddato shebbammikdash. veshemen shel minchot hayyachid belog shebbammikdash. keminyan haesronot kach minyan hallogin:
Berutze hammiddot shel solet chol sheen gav haissaron kodesh. uverutze hayyayin vehashshemen kodesh lefi shehu yored al gav hakkeli. uchele hallach nimshechu mibbifnim umibbachutz. velamma yitkaddeshu habberutzin af al pi sheen kavvanat hammoded ella lema shebbakkeli bilvad kede shello yomru motziin mikkele sharet lechol:
Ma hayu osin babberutzin. im yesh sham zevach acher yakrivu immo. veim lanu yippaslu belina. veim lav mekayyetzin bahen hammizbeach:
Ketzad lokchin bahem olot. habbasar lashshem vehaorot lakkohanim:
Hassolet im hashshemen shel nesachim enan meakkevin et hayyayin velo hayyayin meakkevan. velo hannesachim meakkevin et hazzevach ella mevi adam karbano hayyom unesachav achar asara yamim echad yachid veechad tzibbur. vehu shello kadshu hannesachim bichli sharet aval im netanan lichli sharet im lanu yippaslu belina:
En meviin nesachim ella min hachullin. lo yeviem lo min hatteruma velo mimmaaser sheni velo min habbikkurim. vaafillu toda shemmevi lachmah min hammaaser lo yevio nesachim ella min hachullin:
Kol shiure hannesachim haemurin besefer yechezkel uminyan otan hakkarbanot vesidre haavoda hakketuvim sham kullam milluim hen veen nohagin ledorot ella hannavi tzivva uferesh ketzad yihyu makrivin hammilluin im chanukkat hammizbeach bime hammelech hammashiach kesheyyibbane bayit shelishi:
Ucheshem shehikrivu hannesiim bachanukkat hammizbeach devarim sheen kemotan ledorot vehikrivu beshabbat kach hannasi makriv chanukkato beshabbat leatid kaasher meforash sham. vechen karbanot shehikrivu bime ezra habbaim mehashshevi milluim hayu veenan nohagin ledorot. aval devarim hannohagim ledorot hem divre tora shepperashnu kemo sheheetikum mippi moshe rabbenu en lehosif alehem veen ligroa:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:
Shennayim sheratzu lehavi shelamim o ola beshuttafut meviin ben beneder ben bindava. vaafillu of yavo beshuttafut:
Veechad anashim veechad nashim o avadim meviin kol hakkarbanot. aval haakkum en mekabbelin mehen ella olot bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 25)</small> "umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem". afillu olat haof mekabbelin min hannachri af al pi shehu oved avoda zara. aval en mekabbelin mehen shelamim velo menachot velo chattaot vaashamot. vechen olot sheenan baot beneder unedava en mekabbelin otan min hannachri kegon olat yoledet vechayyotze bah meolot sheenan baot mishshum neder velo mishshum nedava:
Nachri shehevi shelamim makrivin otan olot shehaakkum libbo lashshamayim. nadar shelamim unetanam leyisrael al menat sheyyitkapper bahen leyisrael ochlin otan hayyisreelim keshalme yisrael. vechen im netanan lakkohen kohen ochlan:
Yisrael shehu mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbat befarhesya en mekabbelin mimmennu karban kelal. afillu haola shemmekabbelin otah min hannachrim en mekabbelin otah min hammumar hazze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 2)</small> "adam ki yakriv mikkem" mippi hashshemua lamdu mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hammumar. aval im haya mumar lishar averot mekabbelin mimmennu kol hakkarbanot kede sheyyachazor bitshuva. haya mumar laavera vehu mefursam veyadua laasotah vehurgal bah ben lehacheis ben leteavon en mekabbelin mimmennu karban leotah avera. ketzad. kegon shehaya ragil leechol chelev ben lehacheis ben leteavon veshagag veachal chelev vehevi chattat en mekabbelin otah mimmennu: 
Olot haakkum en meviin immahen nesachim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 13)</small> "kol haezrach yaase kacha". aval niskehem kerevin mishshel tzibbur shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 12)</small> "kacha taasu laechad kemisparam". veenan teunot semicha sheen semicha ella beyisrael baanashim lo benashim:
Kol karbenot behema sheyyakriv hayyachid ben chova ben nedava somech alehen keshehen chayyin. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 2)</small> "vesamach yado al rosh karbano". mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol karban bemashma chutz mippesach uvechor umaaser:
Haof eno taun semicha. vechen kol hammaot sheddinan sheyyippelu lattevot shel nedava shekkevar bearnu behilchot shekalim shekkullan yavou olot en baal otan hammaot somech al otah haola veeno mevi aleha nesachim ella nesacheha mishshel tzibbur veaf al pi shehaya kohen avodatah veorah shel anshe mishmar:
Hakkol somchin chutz mecheresh shote vekatan veeved veishsha vesuma venachri. veen hashshaliach somech sheen semicha ella bivalim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 2)</small> "vesamach yado" lo yad ishto velo yad avdo velo shelucho:
Chamishsha sheheviu zevach echad kullan somchin alav ze achar ze. lo sheyyismechu kullan bevat achat. mi shemmet vehinniach karbano ola o shelamim hare yorsho mevio vesomech alav umevi nesachav:
En semicha bekarbenot hatztzibbur chutz mishshete semichot. al sair hammishtalleach veal par helem davar. ushelosha min hassanhedrin somchin alav. vedavar ze halacha mippi moshe rabbenu sheen betzibbur ella shete semichot:
En somchin ella baazara. samach chutz laazara chozer vesomech mibbifnim. veim haya baal hakkarban omed bachutz vehichnis yado lefanim vesamach semichato keshera. vehu sheyyismoch bechol kocho. veen somech ella tahor veim samach hattame samach:
Uvemakom shessomchin shochatin. vetechef lismicha shechita. veim shachat bemakom acher o sheshshaha shechitato keshera. vehassemicha sheyare mitzva hi lefichach im lo samach kipper veenah meakkevet veaf al pi chen maalin alav keillu lo kipper:
Vetzarich hassomech lismoch bechol kocho bishte yadav al rosh habbehema shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 4)</small> "al rosh hala" lo al hatztzavvar velo al hatztzedadin. velo yihye davar chotzetz ben yadav uven habbehema:
Vechetzad somech. im haya hakkarban kodesh kadashim maamido batztzafon ufanav lammaarav vehassomech omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav umanniach shete yadav ben shete karnav umitvadde al chattat avon chattat veal asham avon asham. veal haola mitvadde avon ase vaavon lo taase shennittak laase:
Ketzad mitvadde. omer chatati aviti pashati veasiti kach vechach vechazarti bitshuva lefanecha vezo kapparati. haya hakkarban shelamim somech bechol makom sheyyirtze min haazara bimkom shechita. veyerae li sheeno mitvadde al hashshelamim aval omer divre shevach:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4:
Kol hakkarbanot en makrivin otan ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 38)</small> "beyom tzavvoto et bene yisrael lehakeriv et karbenehem" bayyom velo ballayla. lefichach en shochatin zevachim ella bayyom veen zorkin damim ella beyom hashshechita shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 16)</small> "beyom hakerivo et zivcho" beyom hazzevicha tihye hahakrava. vechevan sheshshaka hachamma nifsal haddam:
Kol shekkarvu mattirav bayyom maalin oto al hammizbeach kol hallayla. ketzad. zevachim shennizrak damam bayyom maktirin emurehen ballayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vechen evre haolot maktirin otan ballayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. uchede leharechik min happeshia amru chachamim sheen maktirin haemurin veevre haola ella ad chatzot hallayla:
Af al pi shemmuttar lehaketir emurin veevarim ballayla en meacharin otan ledaat. ella mishtaddelin lehaketir hakkol bayyom. chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare hekter emurin veevarim af al pi shekkesherim ballayla dochin et hashshabbat bizmannan veen meacharin otan lemotzae shabbat:
Kol davar sheeno karev ella bayyom kegon hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret umenachot hannisrafot muttar lehakerivan im mevo hashshemesh. vehem mitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla keevre ola:
Hannesachim habbaim im hazzevach en kerevin ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleniskechem uleshalmechem". makkish nesachim lishlamim ma shelamim bayyom af nesachim bayyom. aval hannesachim habbaim bifne atzman mitkaddeshin ballayla ukerevin ballayla. lefichach im nizdammenu lo nesachim habbain bifne atzman makdishan umakrivan ballayla vaalot hashshachar poselet bahen keevre haolot:
Kol hayyom kasher lismicha velishchita velimlika lehekter lehaggasha ulehazzaya velitnufa velikmitza ulekarban hammusafin. vechol hallayla kasher lehaketir emurin veevarim. ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato bayyom kasher kol hayyom. vedavar shemmitzvato ballayla kasher kol hallayla. veaf al pi chen zerizin makdimin lemitzvot:
Kol hazzevachim en shochatin otan lechattechilla ella besakkin mikkele sharet. veim shachat bechol davar sheshshochatin bo hachullin afillu bikrumit shel kane kesherin:
Vechol hazzevachim shekkibbel middamam pachot mikkede hazzaya lo nitkaddesh haddam. vetzarich lehitkavven lekabbel kol haddam. ketzad hu ose. ochez hassimanim beyado umotzian im havveridin letoch hammizrak. veshochet shenayim o rov shenayim kede sheyyitkabbel haddam kullo bichli. umagbiah hassakkin lemala kede shello yered haddam mealeha ella min hatztzavvar. vedam shebbassakkin mekannecho bisfat hammizrak:
Avir hakkeli hare hu kichli. haya mekabbel haddam venifchatu shule hammizrak kodem sheyyaggia haddam laavir hammizrak hannifchat lo nitkaddesh haddam. shehaavir sheen sofo lanuach eno kemunnach:
Kol hazzevachim tzarich haoved shettihye machshavto leshem hazzevach uleshem bealav bishat zevicha uvishat kabbalat haddam uvishat holachat haddam uvishat zerikato al hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 15)</small> "uvesar zevach todat shelamav" shettihye zevicha im shear arba haavodot leshem shelamav. vechen shear hakkarbanot. veim shachat veavad shear avodot setam velo chashav kelal beola uvishlamim hare hen kesherim vealu labbealim:
Vetzarich shettihye machshavto bishat shechitat haola leshem shishsha devarim. leshem hazzevach. uleshem hazzoveach. veshehazzevach lehashshem baruch hu. vesheyyaktiro laishshim. veshehaktarato lereach bilvad. veshereach ze nachat ruach lifne hashshem. veim shachat setam kasher kemo shebbearnu. vehashshochet chattat veasham tzarich shettihye machshavto leshem oto hachet shebba alav:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 5:
Kevar bearnu sheshshechitat hakkadashim keshera bezarim umikkabbalat haddam veelach mitzvat kehunna vechol hazzevachim kibbul daman bichli sharet beyad kohen. aval mekom shechitatan umekom kibbul daman eno shave bechullan:
Ketzad. kadshe kadashim en shochatin otan veen mekabbelin et daman ella bitzfon hammizbeach bechol hammakom shebbearnu gevulotav bitchillat sefer ze. vekadashim kallim shechitatan vekibbul daman bechol makom min haazara:
Uminnayin sheen shochatin kadshe kadashim ella batztzafon. shehare neemar beola <small>(Vayikra 1 11)</small> "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona" uvechattat hu omer <small>(Vayikra 6 18)</small> "bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat". ucheshem shehachattat nikret kodesh kadashim kach haola nikret kodesh kadashim. uveasham hu omer <small>(Vayikra 7 2)</small> "bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham". veshalme tzibbur hukkeshu lechattat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 19)</small> "vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat ushene chevasim bene shana lezevach shelamim" lefichach hen kadshe kadashim kechattat venishchatin bimkom shechitatah. umekom shechita hu mekom hakkabbala:
Uminnayin sheshshochatim kadashim kallim bechol haazara afillu achore hahechol. shehare neemar bishlamim <small>(Vayikra 3 2)</small> "ushechato petach ohel moed" lehacheshir kol haruchot shehare lo yiched lahem ruach. vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim kallim. veim shechatam bahechol kesherim. aval im shechatan begaggo shel hechol pesulin sheen haggaggot reuyot lishchita kelal ella bekarka haazara: 
Shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol pesulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 2)</small> "petach ohel moed" bizman sheppatuach. afillu hayu daltotav muggafot hare ze kenaul. aval happarochet shealav enah poselet:
Haola vehaasham vehashshelamim ben shel yachid ben shel tzibbur zerikat dam shelashtan al gabbe hammizbeach shava leola. vechetzad hu ose. keshellokeach hakkohen haddam bammizrak vezorek mimmennu bammizrak shete zerikot al shete zaviyyot hammizbeach baalachson mechatzi hammizbeach ulematta al keren mizrachit tzefonit veal keren maaravit deromit. umitkavven kesheyyizzarek haddam al hakkeren sheyyihye haddam makkif al hazzaviyyot kemin gam. kede sheyyimmatze haddam shel shete mattanot al arbaa katle hammizbeach lefi shenneemar beola uvishlamim <small>(Vayikra 7 2)</small> <small>(Vayikra 9 18)</small> "saviv" vehu haddin leasham. usheyare haddam nishpachin al hayesod hadderomi: 
Hachattaot hanneechalot daman taun arba mattanot al arba karnot hammizbeach hachitzon mechatzi mizbeach ulemala lefi shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 4 25)</small> <small>(Vayikra 4 34)</small> "al karnot hammizbeach". vechetzad hu ose. keshellokeach hakkohen haddam bammizrak molicho etzel hammizbeach vetovel etzbao hayemanit hassemucha laggudal bedam. vesomech beetzbao haggedola mikkan uvaggudal mikkan umechatte veyored keneged chuddah shel keren ad sheyyichle kol haddam shebbeetzbao. vechen hu ose bechol keren vekeren. veim natan samuch lakkeren keamma achat mikkan o mikkan kipper: 
Vetzarich litbol etzbao al kol keren vekeren. uchesheggomer hannetina al hakkeren mekanneach etzbao bisfat hammizrak. veachar kach tovel paam sheniyya. sheshsheyare haddam shebbeetzbao pesulin litten mehen al keren acheret:
En bechol hakkarbanot karban shettaun hazzayat dam beetzbao ella chattat bilvad shenneemar bah <small>(Vayikra 9 9)</small> "vetaval etzbao baddam". vetzarich sheyyihye sham dam kede tevila lo sheyyissafeg etzbao middam:
Uminnayin hu matchil. ole bakkevesh ufone limino umehallech al hassovev venoten bekeren deromit mizrachit techilla. veachar kach bakkeren hashsheniyya hassemucha lah shehi mizrachit tzefonit. veachar kach bekeren shelishit hassemucha lah shehi tzefonit maaravit. veachar kach bekeren reviit hassemucha lah shehi maaravit deromit. veal yesod otah hakkeren shehishlim bah hammattanot hu shofech sheyare haddam shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 18)</small> "veet kol haddam yishpoch el yesod mizbach" (hala) ze yesod deromi: 
Kol hachattaot hannisrafot damam nichnas lefanim lahechol umazzin mimmennu sham kaasher meforash battora. usheyare haddam shofchan al yesod hammaaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon shehu pogea bo techilla betzeto min hahechol:
Vehechan mazzin middaman. vechamma mazze mehem. par vesair shel yom hakkippurim dam kol echad mehen taun shemone hazzayot al ben habbaddim ushemone al happarochet. umearev dam happar vehassair umazze mishshenehem arba hazzaot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav shebbahechol. vesheva hazzayot al emtzao shel mizbeach ze kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot avodat yom hakkippurim. veim lo kivven bahazzayot shebbifnim kesherot:
Parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin zorek dam mikkol echad mehem sheva hazzayot al happarochet hammavdelet ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim. vearba hazzayot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav:
Vechol haddamim hannittanin al mizbach hazzahav keshehu nichnas omed ben hammizbeach lammenora vehammizbeach lefanav. venoten al karnot hammizbeach mibbachutz. matchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit litzfonit maaravit lemaaravit deromit lidromit mizrachit:
Par kohen mashiach habba al kol hammitzvot kohen hammashiach atzmo mekabbel damo umazze mimmennu mibbifnim veim kibbel vehizza kohen hedyot kasher:
Seire avoda zara vehen seirin hannisrafin lo nitparesh bahen battora ketzad noten daman ulehechan hu noten. ella lefi shehen chattat hakkahal dinan kedin par helem shehu chattat hakkahal lechol haamur bo lemattan damim velisrefa uletamme et hassoref:
Habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach dam kol echad mehen taun mattana achat bishficha keneged hayesod bee zo ruach sheyyirtze mishshelosh zaviyyot hammizbeach. shehare keren mizrachit deromit lo haya lah yesod kemo shebbearnu. uminnayin sheenan teunin ella mattana achat shehare neemar bivchor <small>(Bamidbar 18 17)</small> "veet damam tizrok al hammizbeach" mippi hashshemua lamdu shehu haddin bemaaser uvefesach shennoten daman mattana achat kivchor:
Kol hazzevachim maktirin emurehen al gabbe hammizbeach achar shezzorkin haddam techilla. vechol hazzevachim mafshitin otan veachar kach motziin et emurehen. veen mafshitin otan ad sheyyizzarek haddam. chutz mechataot hannisrafot sheen mafshitin otam kelal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 27)</small> "et oram veet besaram". nimtzeta omer zorek techilla veachar kach mafshit vekorea umotzi haemurin umaktir:
Kol orot kadshe hakkadashim lakkohanim ben bekarbenot tzibbur ben bekarbenot yachid shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "or haola asher hikriv". aval orot kadashim kallim labbealim. vechol ola shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah lo zachu hakkohanim beorah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "lat ish" ola shealta leish:
Kol kadshe hakkadashim sheera bahen pissul kodem hefshetan en orotehen lakkohanim. leachar hefshetan oran lakkohanim. vechol haorot mechallekin otan anshe mishmar benehen meerev shabbat leerev shabbat:
Hammatpis olato levedek habbayit. vechen hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen zecharim sheddinan sheyyikkarvu olot en orotehen lakkohanim shenneemar olat ish perat leolat hekdesh. ella yimmachru haorot veyippelu levedek habbayit. echad <small>(Vayikra 7 8)</small> "olat ish" o ishsha o akkum o eved orotehen lakkohanim lo neemar ish ella lehotzi hahekdesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 6: Mitzvat ase laasot haola kemishpatah hakketuva battora. vechetzad maase haola. shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshit umenatteach umaktir kol hannetachim al gabbe hammizbeach shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 9)</small> "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha":

Tzemer shebberashe kevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman shehen mechubbarin maktirin et hakkol. veim parshu lo yaalu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "olotecha habbasar vehaddam". vechullan sheppaku meal hammizbeach lo yachzir. vechen gachelet sheppaka meal hammizbeach lo yachzir:

Evarim sheppaku meal hammizbeach im yesh bahen mammash afillu paku achar chatzot hallayla yachzir. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla". veim en bahem mammash afillu paku kodem chatzot lo yachzir. nitcharech habbasar veyavash alehen keetz ufaku kodem chatzot yachzir achar chatzot lo yachzir:

Keshemmenatteach evre haola molichin et kol hannetachim lakkevesh umolchin otam sham. veachar kach maalin kol haevarim lerosh hammizbeach. umesir gid hannashe berosh hammizbeach umashlicho al gabbe haddeshen shebbeemtza hammizbeach. vezorek kol haevarim al haesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 27)</small> "habbasar vehaddam". keshem shehaddam bizrika kach kol habbasar bizrika. veachar shezzorkan chozer veorech otan al haesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 12)</small> "vearach hakkohen otam". veevarim shetztzelaan veachar kach heelan lammizbeach en bahem mishshum reach nichoach:

Ketzad menattechin et haola. lo haya shover et haregel ella nokvo vetole bo umafshit. veim haya shor mafshito beli teliyya. umafshit ad shehu maggia lechaze. higgia lechaze chotech et harosh venotno lakkohen. vechotech et hakkeraayim venotnan leacher umashlim et hahefshet. vekorea et hallev umotzi et damo. vechotech et hayyadayim venotnan leacher. ala leregel yemini chotcho venotno lemi shezzacha barosh ushete betzim immah. veachar kach korea et habbehema ad sheyyiggalu (et) hammeayim. venotel et happeder venotno al harosh millemala al bet hashshechita. venotel et hakkeravayim venotnan leacher:

Holech umedichan bammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 13)</small> "vehakkerev vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim". lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin. vechol hammemot kesherin. kamma medichan. hakkares medichin otah bevet [hammedichin] kol tzarkah. hakkeravayim en pochatin mishshalosh peamim. umedichin otan al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:

Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved veeno meziz hakkaved mimmekomo. venokev et hechaze venotno leacher. veole laddofen hayemanit vechotech veyored ad hashshidra velo yigga bashshidra. ad shehu maggia lishte tzelaot rakkot chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkaved teluya bah:

Ba lo laggera manniach bah shete tzelaot mikkan ushete tzelaot mikkan. chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkane vehallev veharea teluyin bah. ba lo laddofen hassemalit umanniach bah shete tzelaot rakkot millemala ushete tzelaot rakkot millematta vechach haya manniach bachavertah. nimtza manniach bishte haddefanot arba tzelaot bezo vearba tzelaot bezo. chotchah venotnah leacher vehashshidra immah vehattechol taluy bah:

Ba lo laoketz chotcho venotno leacher. vehaalya veetzba hakkaved ushete kelayot immah. notel et haregel hassemalit venotnah leacher. ucheseder ze mafshitin umenattechin olat behema. veellu hen hannetachin haamurin battora <small>(Vayikra 1 6)</small> "venittach otah lintacheha":
Bechamma molichin et haevarim lakkevesh. im min hatztzon hi haola molichin otah shishsha:
Harishon barosh uvaregel. harosh bimino vechatmo kelappe zeroo. vekarnav ben etzbeotav. uvet shechita lemala vehappeder aleha veharegel shel yamin bismolo uvet orah lachutz:
Hashsheni bishte hayyadayim shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz:
Hashshelishi baoketz uvaregel. haoketz bimino vehaalya medeldelet ben etzbeotav veetzba hakkaved ushete hakkelayot immo veharegel shel semolo bismolo uvet oran lachutz:
Harvii bechaze uvaggera. hechaze bimino vehaggera bismolo vetzaloteha ben etzbeotav:
Hachamishi bishte defanot shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz:

Hashshishshi bakkeravayim netunin bevazach ucheraayim al gabbehen millemala. im hayta haola keves o ez. aval im hayta ayil molichin hakkeravayim shenayim. vechen hassolet shel nesacheha beyad echad vehayyayin beyad acher. veim haya ayil hassolet bishnayim vehayyayin bishnayim:
Nimtzeta lamed shehakkeves o haez molichin oto shemona lammizbeach. vehaayil molichin oto achad asar:

Hashshor molichin oto arbaa veesrim. harishon molich et harosh. vehashsheni vehashshelishi molichin haregel shel yamin. veharvii vehachamishi molichin et haoketz. vehashshishshi vehashshevii molichin et haregel shel semol. vehashshemini molich et hechaze. vehaggera molichin otah shelosha. teshii vaasiri veachad asar. umolichin shete hayyadayim bishnayim. ushete haddefanot bishnayim. vehakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha hare arbaa veesrim:

Velamma lo yechalleku haevar haggadol shel shor lachalakim. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 6)</small> "venittach otah lintacheha" velo netacheha lintachim. bamme devarim amurim beolot hatztzibbur. aval olot hayyachid im ratzu leholich netacheha befachot meellu o beyoter molichin:

Olat haof ketzad hayta naaset. ole lakkevesh ufana lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit vehaya molek sham et roshah mimmul arpah umavdil. veim lo hivdil pesula. umematztze dam harosh vedam hagguf al kir hammizbeach lemala min hachut shebbeemtza hammizbeach. veim mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf pesula. mitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh keshera:

Venotel et harosh umakkif bet melikato lammizbeach vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim. uva lo lagguf vehesir et hammura vehaor shealeha beyado im hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzin immah umashlichan levet haddeshen:

<small>(Vayikra 1 17)</small> "veshissa oto vichnafav". beyado belo sakkin. veeno tzarich lehavedil shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 17)</small> "lo yavdil" veim hivdil kasher. vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim. lo hesir et hammura velo et hannotza velo et bene meayim velo sefagah bemelach kol sheshshinna bah meachar tamtzit haddam keshera:

Ketzad molkin. kotzetz veyored batztzipporen mimmul oref. im ratza leholich ulehavi molich umevi. veim ratza lihyot dores veyored batztzipporen dores. veim neekru hassimanim eno choshesh. vechotech shidra umifreket belo rov basar. sheim chatach rov basar hare zo kemeta kodem sheyyaggia lassimanin. vetzarich lachtoch shene hassimanim baola keshehu yored. vehammolek besakkin o min hatztzedadin enah melika ella kemi shechanak o nachar. vechol haoref kasher limlika:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 7: Mitzvat ase laasot hachattaot kemitzvatan haamura battora. vechetzad maase chattat hanneechelet. shochet venoten haddam kemo shebbearnu. umafshitah umafrish haemurim umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim. veim ratza litten et haemurin bichli keshemmolichan lammizbeach noten ushear besarah neechol lezichre kehunna baazara:

Vechetzad maase chattaot hannisrafot. shochet vezorek damam kemo shebbearnu. veachar kach koram umotzi haemurim venotnan bichli umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim. umotzi sheeritan chutz lair. umenattechin otan sham kenitche haola beoran. vesorfin otan sham bevet haddeshen:

Shelosha mekomot lisrefa. echad betoch haazara uvo sorfin pesule hammukdashin veemure kadashim kallim shennifselu ufarim useirim shel chattaot hannisrafot im era bahem pasul ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika. kegon shennitmeu o sheyyatzu chutz laazara ad shello higgia zemannan latzet. o shellan habbasar o lanu haemurin shellahen:

Vehammakom hashsheni behar habbayit ushemo bira. uvo sorfin chattaot hannisrafot im era bahen pesul achar tzetan min haazara. vehammakom hashshelishi chutz lirushalayim vehu hannikra bet haddeshen. vesham sorfin chattaot hannisrafot bizman shehen nisrafot kemitzvatan:

Userefat kol hannisrafin keshera bezar uvallayla. vechol hannisrafin chutz laazara kol haetzim kesherin lisrefatan afillu bekash uvigvava shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 12)</small> "al etzim baesh", esh mikkol makom. velamma neemar etzim lehotzi et hassid veet haremetz:

Chattat haof ketzad hayta naaset. molek otah bekeren deromit maaravit kemo shebbearnu veyored betzipparno ad sheyyachtoch hassimanin o rov echad mehen veeno mavdil harosh min hagguf. veim hivdil pasal veloke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 8)</small> "umalak et rosho mimmul arpo velo yavdil". umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach lematta meemtzao. usheyare haddam mitmatztzim al hayesod shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 9)</small> "vehannishar baddam yimmatze al yesod hammizbeach" mikkelal shehannetina al kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzin el yesod vezehu kir hattachton:
Umitztzuy dam chattat haof meakkev. veen lammizbeach bah ella damah vehashshear neechol lezichre kehunna kivsar chattat habbehema:

Ketzad ochez chattat haof bishat melika. ochez shete ragleha ben shete etzbeotav ushete agappeha ben shete etzbeotav. umoteach tzavvarah el rochav shete etzbeotav umolek. vezo meavodot kashot shebbammikdash. veim shinna veachaz bechol makom keshera:
Vechol makom min hammizbeach kasher limlikatah. uvilvad sheyyazze damah lematta meemtza hammizbeach. veim hizza bechol makom keshera. vehu sheyyitten lematta meat middam hannefesh:

Shelosha devarim hayta keren deromit maaravit meshammeshet lemala ushelosha lematta. millematta chattat haof vehaggashat hammenachot usheyare haddam shel olot vechattaot hanneechalot vaashamot ushelamim sheshshofchin aleha. vehashshelosha shel mala nissuch hammayim shemmenassechin bechag venissuch hayyayin shel nesachim veolat haof bizman shehi rabba. veim en keren deromit mizrachit mechila otah nifnin lekeren deromit maaravit veosin otah sham:

Kol haolin lammizbeach olin derech yamin umakkifin veyordin derech semol. chutz min haole leechad mishshelosha devarim ellu shellemala bekeren zo shehen olin venifnin al hassemol lakkeren veosin melachtan vechozrin laakev. umippene ma nifnin lismol kede sheyyifgeu bekeren maaravit deromit techilla. sheim nifnin al yamin umakkifin et kol hammizbeach ad sheyyaggiu lekeren deromit maaravit shemma yitashshen hammayim vehayyayin o shemma yamut haof beeshen hammizbeach:

Lefichach hamenassech mayim o yayin keshehu makkif et hammizbeach lo yihye beyado kelum. umatchil umakkif mikkeren deromit mizrachit lemizrachit tzefonit litzfonit maaravit lemaaravit deromit velo yihye beyado kelum. ucheshemmaggia lemaaravit deromit notnin hammayim o hayyayin beyado umenassech. veim lo hikkif ole ufone al semolo veose melachto veyored:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 8: Chomer bechattat habbehema mishshear kadshe kadashim. sheddam chattat habbehema shennittaz min hakkeli shekkibbel bo haddam kodem hazzaya al habbeged taun kibbus bemayim baazara shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "vaasher yizze middamah al habbeged asher yizze aleha techabbes bemakom kadsh":

Echad habbeged veechad haor harach veechad hassak teunin kibbus. aval haor hakkashe hare hu keetz vegored haddam mealav. veechad dam chattat hanneechelet o dam chattat hannisrefet aval lo dam chattat haof. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 18)</small> "tishshachet hachattat" benishchetet hakkatuv medabber lo benimleket:

Chattat shennifsela en damah taun kibbus. ben shehayta lah sheat hakkosher ben shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher. e zo hi shehayta lah sheat hakkosher. shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatzat chutz laazara. vee zo hi shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher. shennifsela bishchita o bizrikat haddam:

En taun kibbus ella mekom haddam bilvad. vehu sheyyihye al keli sherauy lekabbel tuma verauy lechibbus. aval im nittaz al keli etz o keli mattechet eno taun kibbus lefi sheenan reuyin lechibbus ella gordan bilvad:

Nittaz al or haddag eno taun kibbus lefi sheeno rauy lekabbel tuma. aval im nittaz al or behema. ad shello hufshat eno taun kibbus. achar shehufshat taun kibbus. sheaf al pi sheeno mekabbel tuma atta hare hu rauy lekabbel tuma leachar sheyyitabbed:

Nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged o meal keren hammizbeach o shennishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo venittaz mimmennu al habbeged eno taun kibbus shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "vaasher yizze middamah". lo amarti ella bedam shennitkabbel bichli sharet verauy lehazzaya veyesh bo kede hazzaya:
Natan arba hammattanot veachar kach nittaz min hakkos al habbeged mishsheyare haddam eno taun kibbus. af al pi sheadayin lo zarak hashsheyarim al hayesod. vechen bechattaot hannisrafot:
Nittaz meetzbao achar sheyyatzat hazzaya miyyado eno taun kibbus sheshsheyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulin lehazzaya:

Nittaz min habbeged leveged sheni en habbeged hashsheni taun kibbus. nittaz al beged tame eno taun kibbus. nittaz dam hachattat al habbeged venittaz al dam hachattat dam chullin taun kibbus. aval im nittaz dam hachullin techilla (o afillu dam ola) venittaz alav dam hachattat eno taun kibbus shehare lo nivla bo:

Keshemmechabbesin et mekom haddam mechabbesin oto bemayim yafe yafe ad shello yishshaer lo roshem. vechol shivat hassammanim shemmaavirin al hakketem maavirin al dam chattat. chutz mimme raglayim sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash:

Keli cheres shennitbashshela bo hachattat hanneechelet taun shevira baazara. ucheli mattachot shennitbashshela bo taun merika ushetifa bemayim baazara shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 21)</small> "ucheli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver". af al pi shello neemar kan <small>(Vayikra 7 6)</small> <small>(Vayikra 16 24)</small> "bemakom kadosh" hare dinan kedin hakkibbus. ma kibbus habbeged bakkodesh af shevirat keli cheres ushetifat keli mattachot umerikato bakkodesh. veechad keli shebbishshel bo o keli sheheera letocho roteach:

Merika bechammin ushetifa betzonen. bemayim lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin. vehammerika vehashshetifa kimrikat hakkos ushetifato. vehashshippud vehaaskala magilan bemayim chammim al gabbe haesh veachar kach medichan:

Bamme devarim amurim shebbishshel bahen achar shennizrak damah kehilchato. aval im bishshel kodem zerika o shebbishshel bah besar chattat hannisrefet eno taun merika ushetifa. bishshel bemiktzat hakkeli kullo taun merika ushetifa:

Tzala habbasar [baavir] tannur shel cheres yesh baddavar safek im yishshaver hoil venitbashshela bo o lo yishshaver hoil velo naga bo. velo bechattat bilvad ella kol hakkelim shemmishtammeshin bahen bekadashim al yede chammin ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim teunin merika ushetifa ekev achila. vechen hashshippud vehaaskala magilan ekev achila. veeno menichan ad zeman achila sheniyya. ella kesheyyashlim leechol yagil hashshippud vehaaskala vimarek vayyishtof hakkeli ben kele mattachot ben kele cheres chutz min hachattat sheshshover bah kele cheres. umevashshel veshone umeshallesh miyyad ben bichle mattachot ben bichle cheres umemarek veshotef ad sof achila:

Kele gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama enan teunin merika ushetifa afillu bechattat ella hadacha bilvad. neemar bechattat <small>(Vayikra 6 20)</small> "kl asher yigga bivsarah yikdash" lihyot kamoha. im pesula hi hannogea bah pasul veim keshera hannogea bah yeachel kamoha uvikdushshatah:

Bamme devarim amurim keshennivlea bo. aval negia belo havelaa enah mekuddeshet. veechad hachattat veechad shear kadashim ben kadashim kallim ben chamurim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 37)</small> "zot hattora laola velammincha":
Naga besarah berakik venivla bemiktzato lo nitkaddesh kullo ella chotech mekom habbela:

Keli shebbishshel bo kadashim vechullin o kadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim. im yesh bahen benoten taam hare hakkol neechol kechamur shebbahen. vetaun hakkeli merika ushetifa vehakkol kechamur shebbahen lechol davar. veim lo natan taam ze baze en hakkallin neechalin kachamurim veenan kemotan lechol davar. aval hakkeli taun merika ushetifa:
